kikuyu: Jadolo nyaka non kama opurno kendo oket gik mopurgo tenge kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.

kikuyu: Ka Gideon nowinjo lekno kod kaka oloke, nopako Nyasaye. Nodok e kambi jo-Israel kendo owacho niya, “Chungʼuru malo! Jehova Nyasaye osechiwo jo-Midian e lwetu.”
english: It was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream and its interpretation, that he worshiped. Then he returned into the camp of Israel and said, “Arise, for the LORD has delivered the army of Midian into your hand!”

kikuyu: To joga wigi osewil koda, giwangʼo ubani ne nyiseche mopa manono, manomiyo gichwanyore e yoregi kendo e yore matindo machon. Giseketogi gi wuotho e yore matindo mogondore, kendo e yore ma ok opa.
english: For my people have forgotten me. They have burned incense to false gods. They have been made to stumble in their ways in the ancient paths, to walk in byways, in a way not built up,

kikuyu: Wamiyo Nyasaye duongʼ kuom gik ma opando; to lero tiend weche en duongʼ ni ruodhi.
english: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.

kikuyu: Isemiyo wadoko joma iyanyo e dier joma odak butwa, wan joma inyiero kendo ma ocha gi joma olworowa.
english: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

kikuyu: Isemaya osiepena gi joherana; mudho mandiwa ema koro odongʼ machiegni koda kaka osiepna.
english: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.

kikuyu: To kata kamano, ne ok gidewo wachno, mi gichako dhi malo e piny got, to Musa kata Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye ne ok owuok e kambi.
english: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of the LORD’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.

kikuyu: wuod Ethan, wuod Zima, wuod Shimei
english: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuom chiwo mar kwongʼruok kod chiwo mar hera, losneuru Jehova Nyasaye sewni moyier kaka: misango miwangʼo pep, chiwo mag cham, misango miolo piny kod chiwo mag lalruok.’ ”
english: “‘You shall offer these to the LORD in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’”

kikuyu: Kaka lek biro ka nitie paro mathoth, e kaka weche mar ngʼama ofuwo bedo nikech weche mangʼeny.
english: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.

kikuyu: E Moab anatiek jogo matimo misengini e kuonde motingʼore gi malo, kendo ma wangʼo ubani ne nyisechegi,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
english: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab,” says the LORD, “him who offers in the high place, and him who burns incense to his gods.

kikuyu: Joka Jakobo duto mane odhi Misri ne gin ji piero abiriyo koriwore gi yawuowi ariyo mane Josef onywolo Misri.
english: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.

kikuyu: “Joma chandore kendo joma odhier manyo pi, to ok gininwangʼ, omiyo dwondgi otwo nikech riyo ohingogi. To an Jehova Nyasaye abiro resogi; An, ma an Nyasach Israel ok anajwangʼ-gi.
english: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none. Their tongue fails for thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

kikuyu: Bangʼe jo-Yahudi moko nobiro koa Antiokia kod Ikonio mi gisemo ji odoknigi. Negigoyo Paulo gi kite mi giywaye e lowo nyaka oko mar dala, ka giparo ni osetho.
english: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.

kikuyu: Barzilai ja-Gilead bende nobiro koa Rogelim mondo ongʼad Jordan gi ruoth kendo okowe oweye kodhi.
english: Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king to conduct him over the Jordan.

kikuyu: Nimar obiro konyo joma ochando maywagore, jogo modhier maonge gi jakony.
english: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

kikuyu: Negitimo mano mi gioro Barnaba gi Saulo jotero konygigo ne jodong kanisa.
english: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

kikuyu: Ne giwilo Duongʼ margi gi kido mar rwath machamo lum.
english: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.

kikuyu: Jokedo magi biro bedo gi chuny moikore; gibiro riedo gokinyi kogwen gi duongʼ mamalo, kendo tekri nomedre odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ mana ka tho momoko e lum gokinyi.
english: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

kikuyu: Yot mondo ngamia okadhi e wangʼ sandan moloyo jamoko donjo e pinyruoth Nyasaye.”
english: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Sibuoche maruto makidho le ma gisemako ongʼamo dhogi malach ka dwaro kidha.
english: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.

kikuyu: Kata jadir asere ok noyud thuolo mar ringo, kendo jangʼwech ma jalweny ok noresre, kaachiel gi jalweny moidho faras bende ok notony.
english: He who handles the bow won’t stand. He who is swift of foot won’t escape. He who rides the horse won’t deliver himself.

kikuyu: Ka jopuonjre noneno mano, ne gisin, mi giwacho niya, “Morni iketho malit kayiem nangʼo?
english: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?

kikuyu: Eka Jeremia nowachone jotelo duto kod ji duto niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ne oora mondo akor kuom odni kod dala maduongʼni gigo duto musewinjo.
english: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the princes and to all the people, saying, “The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.

kikuyu: Ne iwacho e chunyi niya, “Abiro idho e polo; abiro guro lochna malo moyombo sulwe mag Nyasaye; kendo anabed e kom duongʼ, ewi got mar chokruok, mantiere malo mogik mar got maler.
english: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!

kikuyu: “Chokreuru un duto mondo uwinji: Ere kata achiel kuom nyiseche manono mosehulo gima biro timore? Oganda ma osiep Jehova Nyasaye ema nokel kum mare kuom Babulon; mirimbe nobed kuom jo-Babulon.
english: “Assemble yourselves, all of you, and hear! Who among them has declared these things? He whom the LORD loves will do what he likes to Babylon, and his arm will be against the Chaldeans.

kikuyu: Chutho, jogi ne oa irwa to ne ok gin jowa. Nikech ka dine gin jowa to dine gisiko kodwa, nimar dhigino nyiso malongʼo ni onge kata ngʼato achiel kuomgi mane ngʼatwa.
english: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nowachone niya, “Ne ni ok inyiso ngʼato wachni. To dhiyo mondo inyisri ne jadolo, kendo ichiw mich ma Musa nochiko, mondo obed ranyisi ne gin.”
english: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

kikuyu: Nikech Wuod Dhano nobiro mondo omany kendo owar jogo manolal.”
english: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”

kikuyu: Gideon nooro joote e piny gode mag Efraim duto, kowacho, “Biuru uked kod jo-Midian kendo udhi nyimgi ma umak pige mag Jordan mochopo nyaka Beth Bara.” Omiyo jo-Efraim duto nowuok oko kendo negikawo pige mag Jordan mochopo Beth Bara.
english: Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill country of Ephraim, saying, “Come down against Midian and take the waters before them as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan!” So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together and took the waters as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan.

kikuyu: Timbene ne richoe moloyo koluwo bangʼ nyiseche mamoko, mana kaka jo-Amor mane Jehova Nyasaye oriembo e nyim jo-Israel.
english: He did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Paa kite ariyo machal gi mane okwongo ka kendo anandikie weche mane ni e kite mokwongo mane itoyo.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Chisel two stone tablets like the first. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

kikuyu: Eka nowachona niya, “Wuod dhano, cham weche mamiyi mondik e kalatasni, mondo ipongʼ-go iyi.” Omiyo ne achame, kendo ne omit ka mor kich e dhoga.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll that I give you and fill your belly and your bowels with it.” Then I ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ondiki ni, “Nikech in, tho ochomowa odiechiengʼ duto; ikwanowa kaka rombo mitero kar yengʼo.”
english: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”

kikuyu: Kane giwinjo mano, ne gitemo mondo gimake, to onge ngʼama notemo mule gi lwete, nikech kindene ne pok ochopo.
english: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Donge ondiki e chiku ni, ‘Ne awacho ni un “nyiseche” ’?
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?

kikuyu: Moloyo mano, Solomon osebedo e kome mar ruoth.
english: Also, Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.

kikuyu: Bangʼ kane osenywol Nowa, Lamek nodak higni mia abich gi piero ochiko gi abich kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri moko.
english: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Tongʼu man yo nyandwat nochakre e dho Nam Mediterania nyaka e Got Hor
english: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.

kikuyu: to kotimo tim marach e nyima kendo ok oluora, to anapar kendo kuom ber mane asechano mar timone.
english: if they do that which is evil in my sight, that they don’t obey my voice, then I will repent of the good with which I said I would benefit them.

kikuyu: Isakar, Zebulun kod Benjamin;
english: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

kikuyu: Ok en Nyasach joma otho, to en Nyasach joma ngima. Urwenyo mabor!”
english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano jaduongʼ mar od twech noketo Josef jatend joma otwe duto e od twech kendo Josef ema norito gik moko duto mane itimo kanyo.
english: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever they did there, he was responsible for it.

kikuyu: En ngʼa mosedhi e polo kendo olor piny? En ngʼa mosechoko yamo moketo ei lwete? En ngʼa mosechoko pi gi lawe kata mosepimo giko mar tungʼ piny? Nyinge to en ngʼa, koso wuode to nyinge ngʼa? Nyisa ane ka ingʼeyo!
english: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?

kikuyu: Ruoth wacho niya, “Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon, ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ngʼato achiel nobi machalo gi Tabor e dier gode, kata ka Got Karmel mantie but nam.
english: “As I live,” says the King, whose name is the LORD of Armies, “surely like Tabor among the mountains, and like Carmel by the sea, so he will come.

kikuyu: Abiro kumo piny kuom timbene mamono, joricho kuom richogi. Abiro tieko wich teko ka mar josunga kendo abiro thiro sunga mar joma wangʼ-gi tek.
english: I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the arrogance of the terrible.

kikuyu: Ka isepiem gi jogo mawuotho gi tielo ma gioli, to ere kaka inyalo piem gi farese? Ka ichwanyori e piny man-gi kwe, ere kaka inyalo wuotho e bungu man Jordan?
english: “If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses? Though in a land of peace you are secure, yet how will you do in the pride of the Jordan?

kikuyu: Landuru lemo gi riyo kech maler kendo luonguru chokruok maler. Chokuru jodongo kod ji duto modakie piny, mondo gibi e od Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, mondo giywagre ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of the LORD, your God, and cry to the LORD.

kikuyu: achiel nochiw kaka misango mar golo richo, to machielo to notimgo misango miwangʼo pep, kaachiel gi misango mar cham. Kamano e kaka jadolo nopwodh ngʼatno e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.”
english: of the kind he is able to afford, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering. The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before the LORD.”

kikuyu: E kindeno ne nitiere ngʼato Jerusalem miluongo ni Simeon, ne en ngʼat makare kendo moluoro Nyasaye. Norito loch mar Israel, kendo Roho Maler neni kuome.
english: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

kikuyu: Kinyne jo-Israel nowuok kendo ne gibworo but Gibea.
english: The children of Israel rose up in the morning and encamped against Gibeah.

kikuyu: Adiera lamo nyiseche mopa ewi gode matindo, kod gode madongo en wuond; adier kuom Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachwa, ema warruok mar Israel yudore.
english: Truly help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains, is in vain. Truly the salvation of Israel is in the LORD our God.

kikuyu: To ka chiengʼ nowuok, chamgo nowangʼ kendo nikech ne gionge tiendegi, ne gitwo.
english: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

kikuyu: To ne ok ayie gigo mane giwacho nyaka nabiro maneno gi wangʼa awuon. Adier kata mana nus wechego ne ok onyisa; kuom rieko gi mwandu iloyo weche ma asewinjo.
english: However, I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ruoth mar Nyandwat nobi mi noger kuonde goyo agengʼa kendo ginikaw dala moro mochiel motegno. Jokedo mag Milambo ok nobed gi teko mar sirogi, kata mana jolwenjgi mabeyo mogik ok nobed gi teko mar siro lweny.
english: So the king of the north will come and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city. The forces of the south won’t stand, neither will his select troops, neither will there be any strength to stand.

kikuyu: Daudi noyudo osekendo Ahinoam ma nyar Jezreel, to giduto ne gin mond Daudi.
english: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they both became his wives.

kikuyu: Kendo ka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osechiwo gi e lwetu mi uloyogi, to une ni utiekogi duto. Kik ulos winjruok kodgi bende kik utimnegi ngʼwono.
english: and when the LORD your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them, then you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nokecho gi jo-Israel kendo nomiyo giwuotho alanda e thim kuom higni piero angʼwen, nyaka ogandani duto mane otimo marach e nyim Jehova Nyasaye notho.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in the LORD’s sight was consumed.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro oronu kwongʼ, ngʼengʼ kod achaya e gimoro amora ma utimo, nyaka urum chuth makaru lal nono nikech richo ma usetimo ma ujwangʼe.
english: The LORD will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.

kikuyu: Kar romb dhood Benjamin ne gin ji alufu piero adek gabich gi mia angʼwen (35,400).
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: kendo miyo idak e ngima moritore kendo mobidhore kitimo gima adiera kendo gima kare kendo mowinjore,
english: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

kikuyu: Kane oketho kido mar abich, ne aneno chunje jomoko mane osenegi ka nitie e bwo kendo mar misango nikech Wach Nyasaye kendo nikech neno mane gisiko gihulo.
english: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.

kikuyu: To ka Sanbalat ma ja-Horon, Tobia ma jatend jo-Amon kod Geshem ma ja-Arabu nowinjo wach gedoni, ne gijarowa kendo buonowa ka gipenjo niya, “Angʼo ma utimoni? Dibed ni ungʼanyo ne ruoth?”
english: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite servant, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they ridiculed us and despised us, and said, “What is this thing that you are doing? Will you rebel against the king?”

kikuyu: To Bangʼ yala, negidwaro weya, nikech negiyudo ni aonge gi ketho mowinjore gi tho.
english: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.

kikuyu: Jodonge nowinjore mondo ondhoge mi onege e Beth Milo, e yo madhi mwalo Sila.
english: His servants arose and made a conspiracy, and struck Joash at the house of Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.

kikuyu: “Harun nyaka wangʼ ubani mangʼwe ngʼar e kendono mar misango okinyi kokinyi koiko teyni.
english: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.

kikuyu: Kata ka ochopo kinde ma ati kendo wiya oselokore lwar, to kik iweya, yaye Nyasaye, nyaka ahul tekoni ni tienge mabiro, kendo ahul timbeni madongo ni tienge duto mabiro.
english: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

kikuyu: Eka Isaya nowacho niya, “Swag ngʼowu.” Negitimo kamano mi gimuone kama ne bur okuodono, bangʼe nochango.
english: Isaiah said, “Take a cake of figs.” They took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.

kikuyu: En ema oketho mier mochiel motegno kendo omuko ohinga mag dala.
english: who brings sudden destruction on the strong, so that destruction comes on the fortress.

kikuyu: Eka Samuel noa Gilgal modhi Gibea e piny Benjamin, kendo Saulo nokwano joma ne ni kode mine oyudo ni gin ji madirom mia auchiel.
english: Samuel arose, and went from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. Saul counted the people who were present with him, about six hundred men.

kikuyu: Manase nonywolo Amon, Amon nonywolo Josia.
english: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.

kikuyu: Nikech Nyasaye tiyo kodwa kaka tik mamit mar Kristo e kind joma iwaro kod joma lal.
english: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:

kikuyu: Nyasaye en Roho, omiyo joma lame nyaka lame e yo ma Roho dwaro kendo gadiera.”
english: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

kikuyu: Eka janabi nogolo kilemba mane ogengʼogo wangʼe mi ruodh jo-Israel nofwenye kaka achiel kuom jonabi.
english: He hurried, and took the headband away from his eyes; and the king of Israel recognized that he was one of the prophets.

kikuyu: Chiwuru magi kumedo ewi misango miwangʼo pep mapile pile gokinyi.
english: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Ruoth Nyasaye biro kelo adhonde ewi mond Sayun, kendo Jehova Nyasaye nomi timbegi mamono nenre ratiro.”
english: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and the LORD will make their scalps bald.”

kikuyu: “Ne akelonu tuoche mag buche machal gi mane akelo ni jo-Misri. Ne anego yawuotu mangʼeny kod ligangla kaachiel gi fareseu mag lweny. Bende ne amiyo tik marach mar joma otho othingʼou e kuondeu mag bworo, to kata kuom mago duto pod ne utamoru duoga ira,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
english: “I sent plagues among you like I did Egypt. I have slain your young men with the sword, and have carried away your horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp, yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: Bende inyalo kawogi mi idwokgi kuondegi? Bende ingʼeyo yo midhigo miechgi?
english: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?

kikuyu: Ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu ma ok agolo e tich mar kendona mar misango anawe mondo omi wengeu opongʼ gi pi wangʼ kendo mondo omi chunyu lit, to ogandani duto to notho kapod gin jomatindo.
english: The man of yours whom I don’t cut off from my altar will consume your eyes and grieve your heart. All the increase of your house will die in the flower of their age.

kikuyu: Baw sirnigo gi dhahabu kendo los ratege mag dhahabu mondo omak raidhi miriwogo. Bende baw raidhigo gi dhahabu.
english: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.

kikuyu: Harun nodwokogi niya, “Kawuru sitadi mag dhahabu ma yawuotu kod nyiu orwako mondo ukelna.”
english: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”

kikuyu: Joma norwako weche Petro ne obatisi, kendo chiengʼno ji alufu adek nomedore e kwan mar joma oyie kuom Kristo.
english: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.

kikuyu: Yesu nochopo kar liel ka chunye nigi kuyo maduongʼ moloyo. Ne en rogo, kendo noyie kidi e dhoge.
english: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

kikuyu: “Jatwengʼo molony ema nyaka los law akor mar ngʼado bura, kolose gi dhahabu gi usi marambulu gi maralik kod marakwaro kod law mayom mar katana kendo momin maber ka law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod.
english: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.

kikuyu: Jehoshafat ne ja-higni piero adek gabich kane obedo ruoth kendo norito piny kodak Jerusalem kuom higni piero adek gabich. Min mare ne nyinge Azuba nyar Shilhi.
english: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

kikuyu: kendo bangʼ mano nochako yalo Injili e sinagoke, kowacho ni Yesu en Wuod Nyasaye.
english: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

kikuyu: gi ogwe gi kalagwena gi olele gi obongo-bongo kod ongʼongruok.
english: the gecko, and the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.

kikuyu: Owacho, ‘Anagerne an owuon kar dak mara maduongʼ ka en-gi ute mamalo malach.’ Omiyo oloso dirisni malach kuome, olwore gi fito mar yiend sida, kendo obuke gi range marakwaro.
english: who says, ‘I will build myself a wide house and spacious rooms,’ and cuts out windows for himself, with a cedar ceiling, and painted with red.

kikuyu: Negigolo gigo koa e hema, mi gikelogi ni Joshua kod jo-Israel duto kendo gipedhogi oko e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: They took them from the middle of the tent, and brought them to Joshua and to all the children of Israel. They laid them down before the LORD.

kikuyu: Negiweyo chike duto mag Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi magiloso nyiseche ariyo molos e kido mar nyaroya kendo machalo gi siro mar Ashera. Negikulore ne nyisechegi giwegi ma gilamo Baal.
english: They abandoned all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made molten images for themselves, even two calves, and made an Asherah, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served Baal.

kikuyu: Neuru, apaka mar Jehova Nyasaye biro mwomore gi mirimbe, yamo mafuto malich ka futo e wiye joma timbegi mono.
english: Behold, the LORD’s storm, his wrath, has gone out, a sweeping storm; it will burst on the head of the wicked.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼat ma ok oyie kuom Kristo ogweli e chiemo, kendo ihero dhi, to cham gimoro amora moketi e nyimi ma ok ichich gi penjo mathoth e chunyi.
english: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

kikuyu: Kane Petro obiro Antiokia, ne akwere e wangʼe nikech kethone ne nenore ratiro.
english: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata muweyone richone nowenegi, to ka ok uweyonegi, to ok nowenegi.”
english: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

kikuyu: Ahab nowachone Naboth niya, “Yie akaw puothi mar mzabibu alok puoth alot nikech ochiegni gi dalana maduongʼ. To kar puodhono abiro miyi puoth mzabibu maber moloyo, to bende ka ihero to anachuli gimoro amora midwaro.”
english: Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, “Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near my house; and I will give you for it a better vineyard than it. Or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its worth in money.”

kikuyu: Ibhar, Elishua, Nefeg, Jafia,
english: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo minwa nopira e chonge kendo adhodho thunde?
english: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?

kikuyu: Musa noneno ka ji osenjawni kendo kaka Harun noketogi mi gibedo joma wigi tek ma ijaro gi wasikgi.
english: When Moses saw that the people were out of control, (for Aaron had let them lose control, causing derision among their enemies),

kikuyu: En ngʼa manyalo ngʼeyo kethone mopondo? Wena kethoga mopondo.
english: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

kikuyu: Jowete duto man ka ooronu mos. Yogreuru ngʼato gi ngʼato gi mos maler.
english: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

kikuyu: Jo-Yahudigo ema nonego Ruoth Yesu kod jonabi mag-gi, kendo gin ema ne giriembowa oko. Ok gilongʼo ne Nyasaye kendo gimon gi ji duto,
english: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,

kikuyu: ne romo ji alufu aboro mia abich gi piero aboro (8,580).
english: even those who were counted of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.

kikuyu: Pok mar apar gachiel ne mar Azarel gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
english: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: “Kik upar ni abiro donjonu e nyim Wuoro. Ngʼat madonjonu en Musa, ma useketo genou kuome.
english: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

kikuyu: Eka jadolo norwak lepe mayom mag dolo ma oko gi maiye, kendo nojow buru mar misango miwangʼo pep kogolo e kendo mar misango mi oolgi oko e bath kendono.
english: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

kikuyu: Ahero Jehova Nyasaye nikech nowinjo kwayona; nowinjo ywakna kane adwaro kech.
english: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

kikuyu: Ibrahim nochako wuowi mane Sara onywolone ni Isaka.
english: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo diwatho kendo lopewa bende kethore to ineno? Ngʼiewa-wa wabed wasumbinini kaachiel gi puothewa kuom chiemo mondo mi wan kaachiel gi puothewa wabed mag Farao. Miwa kodhi mipidho mondo kik watho kendo puothewa kik kethre.”
english: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh. Give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land won’t be desolate.”

kikuyu: mi chiengʼno ema Jehova Nyasaye nogolo jo-Israel e piny Misri kochan-gi e dhoutgi.
english: That same day, the LORD brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

kikuyu: Eka Yesu nogoyo nigi ngero ni:
english: He told them this parable:

kikuyu: Wangʼeyo kuma ngʼatni oaye nikech Kristo to kobiro, to onge ngʼama nongʼe kuma oaye.”
english: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”

kikuyu: Ma e nonro mar joka Esau ma kwar jo-Edom manodak e piny gode mar Seir.
english: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:

kikuyu: To jomoko kuomgi chunygi nodoko matek, ne gidagi yie kendo negichako wuoyo marach kuom jo-Kristo e lela. Omiyo Paulo noweyogi, mi okawo jopuonjre odhigo e od puonjruok mar ngʼat ma nyinge Turano, kuma ne gitwakie pile.
english: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.

kikuyu: Tipo Nyasaye noimo gode duto, mana ka yiende sida ma odongo ma bedene olak.
english: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.

kikuyu: Ibiro gwedhou ka un e dala kata ka un oko.
english: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.

kikuyu: Jogi gin sokni maonge pi kendo gichalo gi ongʼwengʼo ma yamo tero. Gima okan nigi mudho mandiwa molil ti.
english: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

kikuyu: Magi e mier matindo kod gwenge mane opog ne dhood Zebulun kaluwore gi anywolagi.
english: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

kikuyu: To Farao nodwokogi niya, “Jehova Nyasaye to en ngʼa, ma dimi awinj dwonde mi awe jo-Israel dhi? Ok angʼeyo Jehova Nyasaye kendo ok anawe jo-Israel dhi.”
english: Pharaoh said, “Who is the LORD, that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go? I don’t know the LORD, and moreover I will not let Israel go.”

kikuyu: Miwa kony mondo walo wasikwa, nikech kony mar dhano onge tich.
english: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

kikuyu: Kane ruoth owinjo weche manie Kitap Chik, noyiecho lepe.
english: When the king had heard the words of the book of the law, he tore his clothes.

kikuyu: Eka jatend jolweny maduongʼ nowacho niya, “An awuon ne achulo pesa mangʼeny mondo abed ja-Rumi.” Paulo nodwoke niya, “An to ne onywola ja-Rumi.”
english: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.” Paul said, “But I was born a Roman.”

kikuyu: Ne adhi ka an-gi gik moko duto, to Jehova Nyasaye oseduoga ka an-gi lweta nono. Uluonga ni Naomi nangʼo? Jehova Nyasaye Maratego osechwada kendo osekuma malit.”
english: I went out full, and the LORD has brought me home again empty. Why do you call me Naomi, since the LORD has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me?”

kikuyu: Miuru Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ mowinjore gi nyinge. Keluru chiwo kendo ubi ire mondo. Ulam Jehova Nyasaye e lerne marieny mar berne.
english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy array.

kikuyu: Nikech, mana kaka wan e achiel gi Kristo e sandruok duto mane oneno, e kaka wan kode e hoch mochiwo.
english: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

kikuyu: Achiegni chako wuoyo; kendo weche duto manie chunya abiro wacho.
english: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

kikuyu: Bende ma e kit tweyo chiemo ma aseyiero, ma ngʼato hore mana odiechiengʼ achiel kende? Koso en mana ka ngʼama okuyo kokulo wiye ka odundu mayamo yuko kata ngʼama onindo e pien gugru kotimo buru? Bende mano e gima uluongo ni tweyo chiemo ma en odiechiengʼ mowal ne Jehova Nyasaye.
english: Is this the fast that I have chosen? A day for a man to humble his soul? Is it to bow down his head like a reed, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under himself? Will you call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD?

kikuyu: Mana kaka misumba ma gombo ni seche mag odhiambo ochop piyo, kata ka ngʼama ondiki marito chudo mare gi geno,
english: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,

kikuyu: “Onge ngʼama ler ka Jehova Nyasaye; kendo onge moro makmana in; onge Lwanda machal gi Nyasachwa.
english: There is no one as holy as the LORD, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.

kikuyu: Samuel nowachone Saulo niya, “Lingʼ thi! We mondo anyisi gima Jehova Nyasaye nowachona otieno mokalo.” Saulo nodwoko niya, “Nyisawa.”
english: Then Samuel said to Saul, “Stay, and I will tell you what the LORD said to me last night.” He said to him, “Say on.”

kikuyu: ma gin nyiseche mane ochamo gik machwe mag misengini mi omadho divai mag misengini michiwo? Koro giwuogi mondo gikonyi, kendo gimiyi kar resruok!
english: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.

kikuyu: Bende ne nitie mesni angʼwen molos gi kite mopa mane owe ni misengini miwangʼo pep, ma moro ka moro borne ne romo fut ariyo gi nus, lachne ne en fut ariyo gi nus, to borne modhi malo ne en fut achiel gi nus. E wigi noketie gik miyangʼogo misengini miwangʼo pep kod misengini mamoko.
english: There were four cut stone tables for the burnt offering, a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high. They laid the instruments with which they killed the burnt offering and the sacrifice on them.

kikuyu: wuod Matathias, wuod Amos, wuod Nahum, wuod Esli, wuod Nagai,
english: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

kikuyu: Kata kamano mon noyud resruok e yor nywolo nyithindo, ka gisiko e yie kod hera gi ngima maler kendo modimbore.
english: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

kikuyu: Eka enokaw diek ariyo kendo ochiwgi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye e dho Hemb Romo.
english: He shall take the two goats, and set them before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Jogi norwako wuoch moyiech kod lewni moti. Makati mane gin-go duto nokethore.
english: and old and patched sandals on their feet, and wore old garments. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.

kikuyu: Ma e ote mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo Malaki mondo omi jo-Israel.
english: A revelation, the LORD’s word to Israel by Malachi.

kikuyu: Dhakono nodhi ir ngʼat Nyasaye mowachone gima osetimore. Eka ngʼat Nyasaye nowachone niya, “Dhiyo mondo ilok modhigo pesa kendo ichulgo gope ma in-go. In kod yawuoti unyalo konyoru gi mago modongʼ.”
english: Then she came and told the man of God. He said, “Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt; and you and your sons live on the rest.”

kikuyu: Ne owita nyaka ei chwodho, mi alokora buru.
english: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ngʼama ogeno kuomi ogwedhi.
english: LORD of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, Kristo e jathek mar singruok manyien, mamiyo joma oluongi yudo girkeni mosiko mosesingnegi, nikech koro osetho kargi kaka misango mamiyo gibedo thuolo kuom kethogi e bwo singruok mokwongo.
english: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

kikuyu: ka udwoko erokamano kinde duto ni Nyasaye Wuoro kuom gik moko duto e nying Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo.
english: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

kikuyu: Joma ongʼeyo nyingi biro geno kuomi, nikech in, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ne pok ijwangʼo joma manyi.
english: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.

kikuyu: “Bangʼe anapwodh dho oganda mondo giduto giluong nying Jehova Nyasaye, kendo gitine gi chuny achiel.
english: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on the LORD’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.

kikuyu: Omiyo ji duto nongʼado Jordan, to bangʼe ruoth bende nongʼado loka. Ruoth nonyodho Barzilai kendo nogwedhe, eka Barzilai nodok dalane.
english: All the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over. Then the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him; and he returned to his own place.

kikuyu: To kapo ni jatijno timbene richo, mit owacho e chunye owuon ni, Ruodha odeko oko ahinya,
english: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’

kikuyu: Jotend ji mia achiel mane ni e migepe adekgo notimo mana kaka Jehoyada jadolo nochikogi. Jatend migawo ka migawo nokawo joge mane dhi tich chiengʼ Sabato to gi mago mane onego oywe, mi giduto negidhi ir Jehoyada jadolo.
english: The captains over hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded; and they each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

kikuyu: Eka malaikano nowachona niya, “Pigego mane ineno ma dhako ma jachode obedoe, gin ji gi ogendini mangʼeny kod dhout pinje gi joma wacho dhok mopogore opogore.
english: He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.

kikuyu: Kuom mano ruodha akwayi ni tel e nyim misumbani, to aluwi mos mos gi nyithindo kod jamni nyaka achop iri Seir.”
english: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro rieyo bade maler ka ogendini duto neno, kendo tungʼ piny ka piny none warruok mar Nyasachwa.
english: The LORD has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

kikuyu: gigo manotimo duto aa chakruokgi nyaka gikogi ondik e kitap ruodhi mag Israel kod Juda.
english: and his acts, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

kikuyu: Chakre kogwen nyaka odhiambo inyalo turgi matindo tindo ka ok ongʼeyo, kendo gilal nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.

kikuyu: “Neuru ni dhout jo-Kohath ok ogol oko kuom jo-Lawi,
english: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;

kikuyu: Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Kata bed ni ugengʼona kae, to ok anacham chiembu moro amora. To ka uiko misango miwangʼo pep, to uchiwe ne Jehova Nyasaye.” Manoa ne ok ongʼeyo nine en malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: The LORD’s angel said to Manoah, “Though you detain me, I won’t eat your bread. If you will prepare a burnt offering, you must offer it to the LORD.” For Manoah didn’t know that he was the LORD’s angel.

kikuyu: To kata kamano ne akechogi kendo ne ok anegogi kata tiekogi chuth e thim.
english: Nevertheless my eye spared them, and I didn’t destroy them. I didn’t make a full end of them in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Ji ariyo moko, ma joketho, bende negigolo oko kode mondo ogurgi.
english: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.

kikuyu: Timnegi kaka ne itimo ne Midian, mana kaka nitimo ne Sisera gi Jabin e Aora Kishon,
english: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

kikuyu: Gikanyono nochako neno kendo noluwo bangʼ Yesu, kopako Nyasaye. Ka ji duto noneno mano, negipako Nyasaye.
english: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, anto ne achiwora ne tich mar ohingani. Joga duto nochokore kanyakla ne tich; ne ok angʼiewo lowo moro amora e pinyno.
english: Yes, I also continued in the work of this wall. We didn’t buy any land. All my servants were gathered there to the work.

kikuyu: Jotij hekalu ne gin: nyikwa Ziha, Hasufa, Tabaoth,
english: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

kikuyu: Nyasaye noyie kodgi giduto nikech yie mane gin-go. To Kata kamano onge ngʼato kata achiel kuomgi manoyudo gima Nyasaye nosesingonegi,
english: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,

kikuyu: Ma e kum ma jogi nonwangʼ kuom sunga margi, kendo kuom yanyo kendo jaro jo-Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
english: This they will have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: kaachiel gi nyiroke gi boche mogawogi manie bath oguro kod jwala mabor manie wi chuny kod nyiroke,
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall remove,

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata manolos ubani e yo machal kamano mondo owinj tik mamit ma aa kuome nyaka ngʼad kare oko kuom ogandane.”
english: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa e Thim mar Sinai niya,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

kikuyu: “Gima nyi Zelofehad owacho nikare. Nyaka ipog-gi gimoro kaka girkeni ei wede wuon-gi kendo girkeni mag wuon-gi imigi.
english: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

kikuyu: Eka Naaman kod jotichne duto nodok ir ngʼat Nyasaye. Nochungʼ e nyime mowachone niya, Koro angʼeyo ni onge Nyasaye moro e piny mangima makmana e Israel. Koro kiyie kaw mich moa kuom jatichni.
english: He returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him; and he said, “See now, I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel. Now therefore, please take a gift from your servant.”

kikuyu: Ana nonywolo Dishon. Dishon nonywolo Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran kod Keran.
english: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

kikuyu: Ne ayudo ni ne odonjne kaluwore gi weche moko mag chikegi, to ne ayudo ni onge ketho moro mosetimo manyalo miyo ngʼadne buch tho kata buch twech.
english: I found him to be accused about questions of their law, but not to be charged with anything worthy of death or of imprisonment.

kikuyu: Kik wachal gi Kain mane en koth ngʼama rach, omiyo nonego owadgi mahie. To nonego owadgi nangʼo? Nonego owadgi nikech timbene ne richo, to timbe owadgi ne ni kare.
english: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

kikuyu: Kom duongʼno ne olwor gi kombe moko piero ariyo gangʼwen ma jodongo piero ariyo gangʼwen obedoe. Ne girwakore gi lewni marochere to e wigi negirwake osimbe mag dhahabu.
english: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Abiro duogo Sayun mi adag Jerusalem. Eka Jerusalem noluong ni Dala Maduongʼ Mar Tim Makare, kendo got mar Jehova Nyasaye Maratego noluong ni Got Maler.”
english: The LORD says: “I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be called ‘The City of Truth;’ and the mountain of the LORD of Armies, ‘The Holy Mountain.’”

kikuyu: Jo-Gershon nokwan kaluwore gi dhoutgi kod anywolagi.
english: Those who were counted of the sons of Gershon, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

kikuyu: “Okwongʼ ngʼat moloso kido milamo, kata nyiseche mopa, ma en gima mono e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, tij lwedo mar japecho kendo mochungi kama opondo.” Eka ji duto nodwok niya, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ All the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: Yesu nowacho niya, “Goluru kidino oko e dho liel.” To Maritha ma nyamin ngʼat mane othono nokwer niya, “Ruoth, sani koro en gi tik marach, nimar osetieko ndalo angʼwen nyaka notho.”
english: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”

kikuyu: Ne, asemiyoi pinyni. Dhiuru kendo ukaw piny mane Jehova Nyasaye ne okwongʼore ni nomi Ibrahim, Isaka kod Jakobo kaachiel gi nyikwagi.”
english: Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob—to give to them and to their offspring after them.’”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya, “Kik iluorgi; asechiwogi e lwetu. Onge kata ngʼata achiel kuomgi mabiro sirou.”
english: The LORD said to Joshua, “Don’t fear them, for I have delivered them into your hands. Not a man of them will stand before you.”

kikuyu: Chiwuru misango mar goyo erokamano ni Nyasaye, chopuru singruok mau ne Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo,
english: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko jo-Juda chien nikech timbe Ahaz ruodh Israel nimar nosejiwo timbe maricho e piny Juda, kendo noseweyo luwo Jehova Nyasaye.
english: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel, because he acted without restraint in Judah and trespassed severely against the LORD.

kikuyu: Kendo Solomon noloso gik moko duto mane nitie e hekalu mar Nyasaye kaka: kendo mar misango mar dhahabu, mesni mag makati miketo e Nyim Nyasaye pile,
english: Solomon made all the vessels that were in God’s house: the golden altar, the tables with the show bread on them,

kikuyu: Eka nowacho ni jopuonjrene niya, “Wadoguru Judea.”
english: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”

kikuyu: Samuel nowachone Saulo niya, “Angʼo momiyo ichanda kimiyo awuok oko?” Saulo nodwoke niya, “An gi midhiero maduongʼ. Jo-Filistia osemonja kendo kedo koda, Nyasaye bende oseweya. Tinde ok odwoka, gi dwond jonabi kata e yor lek. Mano emomiyo aluongi ni mondo iwachna gima onego atim?”
english: Samuel said to Saul, “Why have you disturbed me, to bring me up?” Saul answered, “I am very distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God has departed from me, and answers me no more, by prophets, or by dreams. Therefore I have called you, that you may make known to me what I shall do.”

kikuyu: Pelatia, Hanan, Anaya,
english: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,

kikuyu: Jodolo ne gin: Nyikwa Jedaya (mowuok e dhood Jeshua), ji mia ochiko gi piero abiriyo gadek (973),
english: The priests: The children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua: nine hundred seventy-three.

kikuyu: “Wuod ruoth manie diergi biro tingʼo misikene e goke ka piny imore mi oa, kendo ibiro powone kor ot mondo okalie. Obiro umo wangʼe mondo kik one piny kuma odhiye.
english: “‘The prince who is among them will bear his baggage on his shoulder in the dark, and will go out. They will dig through the wall to carry things out that way. He will cover his face, because he will not see the land with his eyes.

kikuyu: Un joma ngʼeyogi tin, nwangʼuru rieko; to un joma ofuwo, nwangʼuru ngʼeyo.
english: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!

kikuyu: Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Ok ungʼeyo gima ukwayo. Bende unyalo madho kikombe ma amadho kata yudo batiso machal gi mitisago?”
english: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”

kikuyu: Kaka parogi mar pogo ber gi rach osetho, koro giwere ni anjawo kod timbe duto ma ok ler ma gigombo timo.
english: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

kikuyu: Wachni nobiro ne Jeremia kuom jo-Yahudi modak Misri Mamwalo man Migdol, Tapanhes gi Memfis kod Misri Mamalo:
english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews who lived in the land of Egypt, who lived at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Memphis, and in the country of Pathros, saying,

kikuyu: Lokri iwe timo marach mondo itim maber; eka inidag e piny nyaka chiengʼ.
english: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

kikuyu: Kane ochopo chiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mar auchiel, e higa mar ariyo mar loch ruoth Darius, Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo gi dho janabi Hagai ne Zerubabel wuod Shealtiel, mane jatend piny Juda, gi Joshua wuod Jehozadak, jadolo maduongʼ kowacho niya,
english: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came by Haggai the prophet, to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,

kikuyu: Ok adwar mondo anenra ka gima abwogo chunyu gi barupena.
english: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.

kikuyu: Achiel kuom jonabigo nodhi ngʼweto e pewe ma giyudo alode makech kod mzabibu ma ok nyal cham; kendo nochoko olembe mage motingʼogi e lawe. Kane odwogo nongʼadogi moketogi ei aguch tedo, kata kamano onge ngʼama nongʼeyo ni gin angʼo.
english: One went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered a lap full of wild gourds from it, and came and cut them up into the pot of stew; for they didn’t recognize them.

kikuyu: Reswa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, kendo chokwa igolwa e dier ogendini, mondo wadwok erokamano ne nyingi maler kendo wabed mamor kwapaki.
english: Save us, LORD, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!

kikuyu: Ka uwinjogi ka gigoyo turumbetegi matek, to ket ji duto ogo koko matek; bangʼe ohinga mar Jeriko nopodh piny kendo ji duto nodonj e iye.”
english: It shall be that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; then the city wall will fall down flat, and the people shall go up, every man straight in front of him.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Kik iterri gi nyaminu mahie, kata nyameru maka wuonu machielo kata maka minu machielo, bedni onywole e dala kae, kata kamoro machielo.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home or born abroad.

kikuyu: Joma yande chamo chiemo mamit, koro gin jokwecho mojwangʼ e wangʼ yore; to jogo ma yande odak e ngima maber koro nindo e pidh yugi.
english: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets. Those who were brought up in purple embrace dunghills.

kikuyu: Bende Nyasaye chiko ite ne ywakne ka masira obirone?
english: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

kikuyu: Chiengʼ Sabato moro, Yesu noyudo kadho e kind puothe mag ngano mochiek, kendo jopuonjrene nochako jako wi ngano moko mochiek, negidunyogi e lwetegi mi, gichamo ngano.
english: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

kikuyu: Isepongʼo chunya gi mor maduongʼ moloyo mor ma gin-go e kinde ma gin-gi cham kod divai mangʼeny.
english: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

kikuyu: Ne okawo rwedhi ariyo mag pur mi oyangʼo mi opogo ringʼo lemo lemo, eka nooro joote gi ringʼogi e piny Israel duto, kowacho niya, “Ma e gima ibiro timne rweth ngʼat modagi luwo bangʼ Saulo gi Samuel.” Eka luoro mar Jehova Nyasaye ne omako ji mine giwuok gi chuny achiel.
english: He took a yoke of oxen and cut them in pieces, then sent them throughout all the borders of Israel by the hand of messengers, saying, “Whoever doesn’t come out after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done to his oxen.” The dread of the LORD fell on the people, and they came out as one man.

kikuyu: “Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye ni kuoma, nikech osewira moyiera, mondo ayal Injili ne joma odhier. Oseora mondo aland ne joma otwe ni gin thuolo, kendo ni muofni ni oyaw wengegi, ne joma isando ni ogonygi,
english: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,

kikuyu: E odiechiengʼ nogono mane gichiwe nyithindgi kaka misango ni nyisechegi manono, ema negidonjoe e kara maler mar lemo mi gidwanye. Mano e gima negitimo e oda.
english: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and behold, they have done this in the middle of my house.

kikuyu: “Wuod dhano, aseketi jarito mar dhood Israel, omiyo winj wachna kendo imigi siem moa kuoma.
english: “So you, son of man, I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and give them warnings from me.

kikuyu: “Eka Ruoth Nyasaye nowachone niya, ‘Lony wuoche e tiendi, nikech kama ichungoeni en Kama Ler!
english: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.

kikuyu: to ne ok ginyal ngʼeye.
english: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

kikuyu: Ngʼute opongʼ gi teko mathoth; kama okadhe, to luoro omako gik moko.
english: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno pi makelo ngima nomol koa Jerusalem, ka nusne ochomo nam ma yo podho chiengʼ. Pigno nosik kamol kinde duto, ndalo oro kata ndalo chwiri.
english: It will happen in that day that living waters will go out from Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea. It will be so in summer and in winter.

kikuyu: Eka negikawo chokegi ma giyiko e tiend yath moro man Jabesh, kendo negitweyo chiemo kuom ndalo abiriyo.
english: They took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

kikuyu: Oneno ni gik moloso miye ohala to tache ok tho gotieno.
english: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.

kikuyu: Eka nowacho ni Jeroboam niya, “Kaw migepe apar obed magi nikech ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Nyasach Israel wacho: ‘Ne adhi pogo loch Solomon kendo adhi miyi dhoudi apar.
english: He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for the LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you

kikuyu: to jadolo nigi thuolo mondo ogo nengo maromre kode nyaka chop e Higa mar Piero Abich, kendo ngʼatno nochul nengono mana godiechiengno, kaka gima owal ni Jehova Nyasaye.
english: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kinyne kogwen, jogo nokawo pundegi kendo negiwuok.
english: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi mamoko mane ni Juda nopog mondo odag e piny Benjamin.
english: Of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah settled in Benjamin’s territory.

kikuyu: Bende nitie janabi kata achiel ma kwereu ne ok osando? Neginego nyaka jonabi mane okoro biro mar Ngʼama Kare. To koro usendhoge mi unege.
english: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.

kikuyu: Bangʼe ngʼat mane orwako law mayom-cha mane otingʼo gir ndiko e bathe noduogo wach kawacho niya, “Asetimo kaka ne ichiko.”
english: Behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, “I have done as you have commanded me.”

kikuyu: To piny Efraim kaluwore gi anywola ka anywola ema: Tongʼ mar pinye mane girkeni mare nochakore Ataroth Adar, ma yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka Beth Horon Mamalo,
english: This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families. The border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beth Horon the upper.

kikuyu: Chwo duto ma Ai nowuok mondo olaw Joshua gi joge, to kane gilawogi kamano, to ne gichwalore mabor gi dala maduongʼno.
english: All the people who were in the city were called together to pursue after them. They pursued Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

kikuyu: Ngʼato angʼata ma ok luor chik Nyasachi kod chik ruoth nyaka kume e yor tho, dare, pe gige, kata tere e od twech.
english: Whoever will not do the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be executed on him with all diligence, whether it is to death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.

kikuyu: Dibed ni iwuoyo kamano mondo omi iket weche ma awacho kare kendo mondo ikaw weche ngʼama neno malit ka gima nono?
english: Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind?

kikuyu: “ ‘Le mogak manyaka ukwer e magi: oyieyo, oyiech gudhugudhu, ngʼech moro amora maduongʼ kata matindo,
english: “‘These are they which are unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,

kikuyu: Pinygi opongʼ kod nyiseche manono; gilamo gik ma gipayo kod lwetgi, gigo ma lwetgi ema oloso.
english: Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.

kikuyu: Rebeka ne nigi owadgi miluongo ni Laban, kendo Laban noringo matek ka dhi ir ngʼatno mane ni e sokono.
english: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.

kikuyu: Kuom mano Farao nowacho ne Josef niya, “Ne, koro aseketi jatend piny Misri duto.”
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.”

kikuyu: Kaka wuowi kendo nyako e kaka yawuoti nokendi; to bende kaka ngʼama okendo mor gi chiege, e kaka Nyasachi nobed mamor kodi.
english: For as a young man marries a virgin, so your sons will marry you. As a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.

kikuyu: moluwo rieko mbesene mowacho niya, “Wuonwa nomiyou tingʼ mapek, an to abiro miyou tingʼ mapek moloyo. Wuonwa nochwadou gi boka, an to abiro chwadou malit ka thomoni makecho.”
english: and spoke to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”

kikuyu: Bangʼ ka Saulo nosekawo loch e piny Israel, nokedo gi wasikgi koni gi koni kaka jo-Moab, jo-Amon, jo-Edom, gi ruodhi mag Zoba to gi jo-Filistia. Kamoro amora mane odhiye ne osandogi.
english: Now when Saul had taken the kingdom over Israel, he fought against all his enemies on every side: against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines. Wherever he turned himself, he defeated them.

kikuyu: Roho Maler nowacho ni Filipo niya, “Dhiyo mondo ichungʼ machiegni gi gari cha.”
english: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”

kikuyu: Donge uparo kaka Akan wuod Zera notimo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, momiyo oganda jo-Israel duto okum? Ok en kende ema notho nikech richone.’ ”
english: Didn’t Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the devoted thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? That man didn’t perish alone in his iniquity.’”

kikuyu: Kendo kuonde duto mane gidhiyoe e dier ogendini to ne gichayo nyinga maler, nikech ji ne wuoyo kuomgi kawacho ni, ‘Magi gin jo-Jehova Nyasaye, to ne oriembogi e lope.’
english: When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned my holy name, in that men said of them, ‘These are the LORD’s people, and have left his land.’

kikuyu: Negidwoke niya, “Wanyalo.” Yesu nowachonegi niya, “En adier ni ubiro metho e kikombe ma amethoe mi obatisu gi batiso mitisago,
english: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;

kikuyu: Odak ewi lwendni maboyo kendo odak kuno nyaka otieno; kendo kind lwendni e kare mar pondo.
english: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home, on the point of the cliff and the stronghold.

kikuyu: To Daudi nodhi malo koa kanyo modak e kuonde pondo mag En Gedi.
english: David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.

kikuyu: Petro nomako bade mi okonye chungʼ gi tiende. Bangʼe noluongo jopuonjre kod mon ma chwogi otho mane ni oko mi omiyogi Tabitha kangima.
english: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.

kikuyu: kendo wach ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Adagi, in Gog, ruoth maduongʼ moloyo Meshek kod Tubal.
english: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.

kikuyu: Adier, adier awachoni, kane pod itin, to nirwakori kendi kendo ne inyalo dhi kamoro amora mihero; to kibiro doko moti, to ibiro rieyo bedeni ne ngʼama chielo ma biro rwakoni lepi mi teri kuma ok idwar dhiye.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”

kikuyu: Ka ineno rwadh wadu kata rombone kolal, kik iwuondri ni ok inene, to kawe idwokene wuon.
english: You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them. You shall surely bring them again to your brother.

kikuyu: An abatisou gi pi, to en obiro batisou gi Roho Maler.”
english: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”

kikuyu: To ne gikok niya, “Gole e wangʼwa! Gole e wangʼwa! Gure!” Pilato nopenjogi niya, “Udwaro ni agur ruodhu?” Jodolo madongo nodwoke niya, “Wan waonge gi ruoth machielo makmana Kaisar kende.”
english: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”

kikuyu: Gik moko nokwan mongʼe kar kwan-gi kod pek mag-gi, kendo pek mag-gi nondik piny e sechego.
english: Everything was counted and weighed; and all the weight was written at that time.

kikuyu: Ka jamecho obuto korito, to omedo keto ji ma ok jo-adiera mangʼeny e kind ji.
english: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.

kikuyu: Nopenjo ji mane odak kanyo niya, “Ere ochot madhako mane obet e akek yo madhi Enaim cha?” To negidwoke niya, “Onge ochot ma dhako ka.”
english: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”

kikuyu: Hezro ja-Karmel gi Parai ja-Arbi.
english: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

kikuyu: Nikech riyo oloyo nyathi madhoth mi koro lewe omoko e dande; kendo nyithindo kwayo chiemo, to onge ngʼama migi.
english: The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst. The young children ask for bread, and no one breaks it for them.

kikuyu: Omiyo ne gigole e gache ma gikete e gari machielo mane en-go ma gikele Jerusalem kama nothoe. Noyike e liete mag kwerene kendo jo-Juda kod jo-Jerusalem duto noywage.
english: So his servants took him out of the chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had, and brought him to Jerusalem; and he died, and was buried in the tombs of his fathers. All Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

kikuyu: dimbruok kod ritruok. Onge chik moro amora makwedo gik ma kamago.
english: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

kikuyu: kata obedo ni chiengʼ mipidhogieno ema gidongoe kendo okinyi ma ipidhogieno ema gichiewoe, onge gima niyudi to makmana chandruok kod rem ma ok rum.
english: In the day of your planting, you hedge it in. In the morning, you make your seed blossom, but the harvest flees away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

kikuyu: to ka otimore bangʼ ka chiengʼ osetuch, to remo nodongʼ e wiye. “Jakuogno nyaka chul gima rom gi gima nokawono, to ka oonge gi gimoro, to nyaka use mondo ochulgo kuo mokwalono.
english: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

kikuyu: Petro noluwo bangʼe kowuok e od twech, to kata kamano pache ne pok odwogo mondo ofwenyne ni gima malaika ne timono en adier, to noparo mana ni oleko.
english: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.

kikuyu: to tim kama, wuoda, mondo ibed thuolo, nikech isepodho e lwet jabathi: Dhiyo kendo ibolri e nyime; bangʼe to ikwa jabathino oweyi thuolo!
english: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.

kikuyu: Wigi nowil gi Nyasaye mane oresogi, Nyasaye mane osetimo gik madongo e piny Misri,
english: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,

kikuyu: Eka ne adhi nyime ka awacho niya, “Gima utimoni ok ber. Donge duluorie Nyasachwa mondo ugengʼ achaya mar joma ok jo-Yahudi ma wasikwa ochayowago?
english: Also I said, “The thing that you do is not good. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the nations, our enemies?

kikuyu: Nyithind jotichni biro dak buti machiegni; nyikwagi nodhi maber e nyimi.”
english: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”

kikuyu: E chandruok ne aluongo Jehova Nyasaye; ne aywak ne Nyasaye mondo okonya. Ne owinjo dwonda gie hekalu mare; ywakna nochopo e nyime, modonjo e ite.
english: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.

kikuyu: Elifaz nonywolo: Teman, Omar, Zefo, Gatam kod Kenaz.
english: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

kikuyu: Wuon mare Isaka nodwoke niya, “Inidag e piny maonge mwandu, kendo motwo ma ok yud koth.
english: Isaac his father answered him, “Behold, your dwelling will be of the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of the sky from above.

kikuyu: Omiyo jal mane obet e bor polo notiyo gi pande mar keyo e piny, mi nokayo piny ka cham.
english: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.

kikuyu: Un mon winjuru chwou mana kaka dine uluoro Ruoth.
english: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

kikuyu: Luoro Jehova Nyasaye e chakruok mar rieko; ji duto moluwo buchene nigi winjo maber. En kende ema owinjore yudo pak manyaka chiengʼ.
english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Chik iti in Ruoth Jehoshafat kaachiel gi jogo duto modak Juda gi Jerusalem! Jehova Nyasaye wachoni kama: ‘Kik ibed gi luoro kendo chunyi kik parre nikech oganda lweny maduongʼni, nimar lweny ok maru, to en mar Nyasaye.
english: and he said, “Listen, all Judah, and you inhabitants of Jerusalem, and you, King Jehoshaphat. The LORD says to you, ‘Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed because of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God’s.

kikuyu: Owete man Lustra gi Ikonio ne wuoyo maber kuom Timotheo.
english: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.

kikuyu: Joma odhier biro chiemo mi yiengʼ; joma manyo Jehova Nyasaye biro pake, mad chunjeu bed mangima nyaka chiengʼ!
english: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise the LORD who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.

kikuyu: Luoro nomako jogwengʼ duto, kendo ji duto manie piny gode Judea ne loso kuom gigi duto.
english: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

kikuyu: Kane jo-Israel ne osetieko nego jo-Ai duto mane ni e pap kod mane ni e thim kama ne giselawogie, kendo kane gisenegogi duto gi ligangla, jo-Israel nodok Ai mi ginego jogo mane odongʼ kuno.
english: When Israel had finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness in which they pursued them, and they had all fallen by the edge of the sword until they were consumed, all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.

kikuyu: Kane bed ni gin fuon achiel, to ringruok dibed nadi?
english: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

kikuyu: Janeno ma ja-miriambo biro lal; to ngʼat mawinje ibiro tieko chutho.
english: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.

kikuyu: Abiro biro iru bangʼ ka asea Makedonia, nikech abiro luwo kuno.
english: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

kikuyu: Rangauru ane ka ok dubwogi; kendo ka ok dumak dhou ka uhum.
english: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.

kikuyu: Rit nyaka watiek juma achiel mar nyasi mar nyakoni; eka abiro miyi Rael kiyie tiyona kuom higni abiriyo mamoko.”
english: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me for seven more years.”

kikuyu: Kane omadho divai moko mowuok e mzabibuno, nomer kendo nonindo duk ei hembe.
english: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.

kikuyu: Eka jotelo moko mag Efraim kaka Azaria wuod Jehohanan gi Berekia wuod Meshilemoth gi Jehizkia wuod Shalum kod Amasa wuod Hadlai bende nodhi mokwero jogo mane oa e lweny.
english: Then some of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against those who came from the war,

kikuyu: Omiyo Jeremia nodhi Mizpa ir Gedalia wuod Ahikam mi odak kode kaachiel gi ji mane odongʼ e pinyno.
english: Then Jeremiah went to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah, and lived with him among the people who were left in the land.

kikuyu: Jo-Merari nokwan kaluwore gi dhoutgi kod anywolagi.
english: Those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo jochuog wer nowero niya, “Bi Heshbon mondo mi ogere kendo; mad dala maduongʼ mar Sihon ochal kaka chon.
english: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;

kikuyu: To kata kamano awachonu ni kata mana Solomon e rwakruokne malich duto ne ok orwakore ka achiel kuomgi.
english: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.

kikuyu: Kapo ni sa moro amora alando ni piny kata pinyruodhi opudh oko, kata kethgi matiekgi,
english: At the instant I speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy it,

kikuyu: to ka ok kamano, to chik iti iwinja; kendo lingʼ mos nimar abiro puonji rieko.”
english: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”

kikuyu: Kuom mano Musa nonyiso Harun kama, “Kaw manna madirom ngʼato achiel chamo mondo iket e agulu. Bangʼe kete e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mondo okane ne tienge mabiro.”
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take a pot, and put an omer-full of manna in it, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept throughout your generations.”

kikuyu: Kane pod gin ji manok e kar rombgi, ne ginok ahinya kendo ne gin welo e pinyno,
english: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

kikuyu: Kane anene, ne apodho e tiende mana ka ngʼat motho. Eka noketo lwete ma korachwich kuoma mowachona niya, “Kik iluor. An e Jal Mokwongo kendo Jal Mogik.
english: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last,

kikuyu: Ne en yien ma jaber, kendo bedene nokar, nikech tiende nochopo nyaka e pige mogundho man e bwo lowo.
english: Thus it was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches; for its root was by many waters.

kikuyu: Kane Yesu osebilo kongʼono nowacho niya, “Duto koro orumo.” Eka nokulo wiye piny, kendo chunye nochot.
english: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

kikuyu: Eka nowachona niya, “Udi mane ni yo nyandwat gi yo milambo mochomo laru mar hekalu ne gin ute jodolo, kama jodolo mabiro e nyim Jehova Nyasaye biro chame chiwo maler mogik. Kanyo ema gibiro ketoe chiwo maler mogik, ma gin chiwo mag cham, misengini mag golo richo kod chiwo mipwodhogo chunje ma bura oloyo, nikech kanyo en kama ler.
english: Then he said to me, “The north rooms and the south rooms, which are opposite the separate place, are the holy rooms, where the priests who are near to the LORD shall eat the most holy things. There they shall lay the most holy things, with the meal offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

kikuyu: Koro yawuot Athalia dhako marachno noseketho hekalu mar Nyasaye kendo negitiyo ni Baal gi gik mopwodhi mag Nyasaye.
english: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up God’s house; and they also gave all the dedicated things of the LORD’s house to the Baals.

kikuyu: Kane oyudo owacho wechegi, jatelo moro nobiro mokulore e nyime kawacho niya, “Nyara otho machiegni. To yie ibi iket lweti kuome mondo obed mangima.”
english: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”

kikuyu: Owetena, asiemou mondo ungʼi maber joma kelo pogruok, kendo keto chwanyruok e yoreu ma ok oluwore gi puonj museyudo. Wereuru kodgi.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

kikuyu: Thuon ma nyinge Goliath, ma ja-Gath nowuok koa e kambi mar jo-Filistia. Borne ne en fut ochiko.
english: A champion out of the camp of the Philistines named Goliath of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span went out.

kikuyu: Nochiko jaote niya, “Ka isetieko nyiso ruoth wechegi duto matimore e lweny,
english: and he commanded the messenger, saying, “When you have finished telling all the things concerning the war to the king,

kikuyu: Abiro chopo tija mar chulo kuor kuomgi, kendo abiro kuomgi ka iya owangʼ matek. Eka giningʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye, ka anachulnigi kuor.’ ”
english: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I lay my vengeance on them.”’”

kikuyu: Ruoth ma dhako mar piny ma milambo nochungʼ chiengʼ bura kaachiel gi tiengʼni kendo nongʼadne bura kaka jaketho, nimar nobiro koa e tungʼ piny kuma bor mondo owinj rieko Solomon, to sani koro nitie ngʼato ka maduongʼ moloyo Solomon.
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

kikuyu: “Chikuru jo-aserni mondo omonj Babulon, jogo duto maywayo atungʼ. Chokreuru bute; kik uwe ngʼato pondi. Chuleuru nikech timbene; timneuru kaka osetimo. Nimar ok osewinjo Jehova Nyasaye, Jal Maler mar Israel.”
english: “Call together the archers against Babylon, all those who bend the bow. Encamp against her all around. Let none of it escape. Pay her back according to her work. According to all that she has done, do to her; for she has been proud against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Kendo Solomon gi chokruok duto nodhi kar lemo motingʼore malo e Gibeon nikech Hemb Romo mar Nyasaye mane Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye noloso e thim ne ni kanyo.
english: Then Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for God’s Tent of Meeting was there, which the LORD’s servant Moses had made in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Mad ruodhi duto mag piny paki, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, e sa ma giwinjo weche mowuok e dhogi.
english: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

kikuyu: Asedak amingʼa ahinya, e dier joma ok dwar kwe.
english: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.

kikuyu: Jotheth kod jo-ohala ema noloso ohinga chakre gorofano nyaka Dhoranga Rombe.
english: Between the ascent of the corner and the sheep gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants made repairs.

kikuyu: Bangʼ bedo Rumi kuom ndalo adek, Paulo noluongo jotend jo-Yahudi mane odak kanyo. To kane gisechokore, nowachonegi niya, “Owetena, kata obedo ni ok asetimo gimoro marach ni jo-Yahudi kata ne timbe machon mag kwerewa, to nomaka Jerusalem moketa e lwet jo-Rumi.
english: After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews. When they had come together, he said to them, “I, brothers, though I had done nothing against the people or the customs of our fathers, still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans,

kikuyu: An mar jaherana, kendo gombone ni kuoma.
english: I am my beloved’s. His desire is toward me.

kikuyu: “Ka ngʼato oketho ni wadgi kendo dwarore ni mondo okwongʼre kendo obiro mokwongʼore e nyim kendo mar misango manie hekaluni,
english: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house,

kikuyu: Abiro miyogi janabi machal kodi moa kuom owetegi, abiro keto wechena e dhoge kendo obiro nyisogi gik moko duto ma achikogi.
english: I will raise them up a prophet from among their brothers, like you. I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I shall command him.

kikuyu: Ka Saulo noneno jolwenj jo-Filistia luoro gi kihondko nomake.
english: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly.

kikuyu: Wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Solomon kowacho niya,
english: The LORD’s word came to Solomon, saying,

kikuyu: To Chik owuon ok otenore kuom yie, nikech Muma wacho niya, “Ngʼat moluwo chikegi nobed mangima kuomgi.”
english: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”

kikuyu: Apoya nono raumne mapek mar chuma noel kendo ne aneno dhako moro kobet piny ei atongano!
english: and behold, a lead cover weighing one talent was lifted up—and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket.”

kikuyu: Kane mano osetimore, joma tuo duto mane ni e chulano nobiro moyudo chang.
english: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.
