kikuyu: “ ‘Ne akelou nyaka e piny jo-Amor manodak yo wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan. Negikedo kodu, to naketogi e lwetu. Ne atiekogi chuth e nyimu, mi ukawo pinygi.
english: “‘I brought you into the land of the Amorites, that lived beyond the Jordan. They fought with you, and I gave them into your hand. You possessed their land, and I destroyed them from before you.

kikuyu: To Yesu nongʼicho koni gi koni, eka owacho ni jopuonjrene niya, “Mano kaka en gima tek mondo ja-mwandu odonji e pinyruoth Nyasaye!”
english: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”

kikuyu: To dhako moro ne ni kanyo mane osebedo ka iye chwer kuom higni apar gariyo.
english: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,

kikuyu: Jogo duto maloso nyiseche manono gin joma nono, kendo gik ma gihero ok kony gimoro. Joma wuoyo e logi gin muofni momemore kendo mano kelonegi mana wichkuot.
english: Everyone who makes a carved image is vain. The things that they delight in will not profit. Their own witnesses don’t see, nor know, that they may be disappointed.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, ji nokelo joma tuo mi giketogi e bath yore ka gipielogi e kitendini kod pere, mondo kata mana tipo mar Petro oum moko kuomgi kokalo butgi.
english: They even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.

kikuyu: To ngʼeuru ma maber ni ka dine wuon ot ngʼe ni kar sa adi mar otieno ma jakuo biroe, dine osiko korito, kendo dine ok oweyo ode otur gi jakuo.
english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

kikuyu: Wuo gi nyithind Israel kendo unyisgi kama: Ka ngʼato dende chwer bedni en nyach, remo, tutu, kata nyodo, to gik machwer kawuok e dendego ogak.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.

kikuyu: Donge in ema nomiyo nam oduono, ma gin pige mano chokore kuonde matut, kendo niloso yo e kind nam matut mondo joma ne ireso ongʼadi kadhi loka cha?
english: Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to pass over?

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni achalo pien tingʼo divai molier e iro, to wiya pok owil gi chikeni.
english: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ka oganda mar jo-Israel duto otimo richo ka ok gingʼeyo maponi gitimo gimoro ma chik Jehova Nyasaye okwero, kata obedo ni gikia, to gin joricho.
english: “‘If the whole congregation of Israel sins, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and are guilty;

kikuyu: Kik utimne ngʼwono, kendo nyaka ugol e dier jo-Israel richo mar chwero remb ngʼat maonge ketho, eka unudhi maber.
english: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall purge the innocent blood from Israel that it may go well with you.

kikuyu: Eka Roho mar Nyasaye nolor kuom Zekaria wuod Jehoyada jadolo. Nochungʼ e nyim ji kowacho niya, “Nyasaye wacho kama: ‘Angʼo momiyo ok urito chike Jehova Nyasaye? Omiyo ok unuyud hawi nikech useweyo Jehova Nyasaye omiyo en bende oseweyou.’ ”
english: The Spirit of God came on Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest; and he stood above the people, and said to them, “God says, ‘Why do you disobey the LORD’s commandments, so that you can’t prosper? Because you have forsaken the LORD, he has also forsaken you.’”

kikuyu: Kane Tou ruodh Hamath owinjo ni Daudi noloyo jolweny duto mag Hadadezer,
english: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato okendo nyamin mare ma nyar wuon kata ma nyar min, ma giterore kode, to otimo gima kwero. Nyaka neg-gi ka ji duto neno nikech oterore gi nyamin, koro nyaka oyud kum.
english: “‘If a man takes his sister—his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter—and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a shameful thing. They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness. He shall bear his iniquity.

kikuyu: Yawuot Ezra ne gin: Jetha, Mered, Efer kod Jalon. Achiel kuom mond Mered nonywolo Miriam, Shamai kod Ishba mane wuon Eshtemoa.
english: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

kikuyu: Koro abiro aa malo kendo abiro wuotho koni gi koni e dala, abiro menyo e yore kod kuonde duto mopondo mag dala; abiro manyo ngʼat ma chunya ohero. Omiyo ne amanye to ne ok ayude.
english: I will get up now, and go about the city; in the streets and in the squares I will seek him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.

kikuyu: Ne akawo barup ngʼiepo, mano mogoye amuri momwon motingʼo singruok kod chike mag ngʼiewo lowo, to gi mano ma ok omuon
english: So I took the deed of the purchase, both that which was sealed, containing the terms and conditions, and that which was open;

kikuyu: Kane gikelo nyathi kanyna ne Yesu, ne gipedho lepgi e ngʼeye mi Yesu obetie.
english: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.

kikuyu: Wasedak e hembe kendo waserito gimoro amora ma kwarwa Jehonadab nochikowa.
english: but we have lived in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

kikuyu: Tongʼu man yo wuok chiengʼ, nochakre Hazar Enan nyaka Shefam.
english: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

kikuyu: Jatelono nobiro momako Paulo, kendo nogolo chik mondo otweye gi nyoroche ariyo. Bangʼe nopenjogi niya, “Ngʼatni en ngʼa? To osetimo angʼo?”
english: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.

kikuyu: Ne asenyisou ni ubiro tho e richou. Ka utamoru yie ni an ngʼama asebedo ka awachonu ni an, to ubiro tho e richou adier.”
english: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye biro rite e kitandane mar tuo midekre kendo obiro miyo oa malo e kitandane ka ohewore.
english: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

kikuyu: Angʼo momiyo ikuyo, yaye chunya? Angʼo momiyo inyosori, yaye chunya? Ket genoni kuom Nyasaye, nikech pod abiro pake, en e Jawarna kendo Nyasacha.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.

kikuyu: “Emomiyo, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Pod ok uluora; pod ok uyie weyo oweteu thuolo. Omiyo koro awacho mondo owenu thuolo mondo onegu gi ligangla, masiche kod kech. Anami ogendini manie piny duto bedo gibuok ka ginenou.
english: Therefore the LORD says: “You have not listened to me, to proclaim liberty, every man to his brother, and every man to his neighbor. Behold, I proclaim to you a liberty,” says the LORD, “to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine. I will make you be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

kikuyu: To ka ngʼat ma ok ogak kendo ma ok odhi wuoth otamore timo nyasi mar Pasaka, ngʼatno nyaka gol oko kuom jogi nikech ne ok ochiwo misango ne Jehova Nyasaye e kinde moketne. Ngʼat ma kamano noyud kum moromore gi richone.
english: But the man who is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people. Because he didn’t offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

kikuyu: Eka ne aneno ji auchiel kabiro koa yo rangach mamalo, ka moro ka moro kuomgi otingʼo gir lweny mager e lwete. Ne nitie ngʼato kodgi morwako law mayom mane otingʼo gir ndiko e bathe. Negidonjo mi gichungʼ e bath kendo mar misango mar nyinyo.
english: Behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand. One man in the middle of them was clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. They went in, and stood beside the bronze altar.

kikuyu: Koa Kibroth Hatava, ji nodhi nyaka Hazeroth kendo negidak kanyo.
english: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.

kikuyu: Koro ne nitie jo-Yunani moko kuom joma ne biro lemo e Sawono.
english: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.

kikuyu: Mano e kaka yie bende chalo: ka oonge gi tim to en yie motho.
english: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

kikuyu: Omiyo ruoth ne ok odewo kwayo mar ji, nimar Jehova Nyasaye ema nomiyo mano otimore mondo ochop wach mane Jehova Nyasaye owacho gi dho Ahija ja-Shilo ne Jeroboam wuod Nebat.
english: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was a thing brought about from the LORD, that he might establish his word, which the LORD spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

kikuyu: Elisha ngʼat Nyasaye nokecho kode mowacho niya, “Nonego ichwogi piny nyadibich kata nyadiuchiel; eka dine iloyo jo-Aram mitiekogi chuth, to sani to ibiro loyogi mana nyadidek kende.”
english: The man of God was angry with him, and said, “You should have struck five or six times. Then you would have struck Syria until you had consumed it, but now you will strike Syria just three times.”

kikuyu: Omiyo Kain noa e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo nodak e piny Nod, mantie yo wuok chiengʼ mar Eden.
english: Cain left the LORD’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

kikuyu: Jachan gi ngʼat mahinyo ji nigi gimoro achiel machalre: Jehova Nyasaye miyogi wenge maneno kargi ji ariyogo.
english: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives sight to the eyes of both.

kikuyu: Isegolo chik, yaye ruoth, ni ngʼato ka ngʼato mowinjo ywak mar tungʼ, asili, nyagweru, nyatiti, orutu kod kit thumbe mayoreyore to nyaka podhi piny auma kendo lam kido mar dhahabu,
english: You, O king, have made a decree that every man who hears the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music shall fall down and worship the golden image;

kikuyu: Dala maduongʼno ne ogone agengʼa nyaka higa mar apar gachiel mar ruoth Zedekia.
english: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

kikuyu: Apoya nono kane pod gingʼicho, ne ok gichako gineno ngʼato kani kodgi makmana Yesu kende.
english: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.

kikuyu: Chiengʼno Jehova Nyasaye noreso Israel e lwet jo-Misri, kendo Israel noneno ka jo-Misri otho e dho nam.
english: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.

kikuyu: In bende ibiro mer, ibiro pondo, kendo ibiro kwayo kar dak kuom jowasiki.
english: You also will be drunken. You will be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy.

kikuyu: Kendo pinje nongʼe ni jo-Israel nodhi e twech nikech richogi, kendo ne ok gibedona jo-ratiro. Omiyo ne alokonegi ngʼeya kendo ne achiwogi ni wasikgi, mi giduto negipodho e dho ligangla.
english: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they trespassed against me, and I hid my face from them; so I gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they all fell by the sword.

kikuyu: Omiyo los yie gi yien motegno, pog iye mondo owuog udi matindo kendo muone gi duogo, iye gi oko.
english: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.

kikuyu: Gibiro dak e piny mane amiyo jatichna ma Jakobo, ma en piny mane kwereu odakie. Gin kaachiel gi nyithindgi kod nyikwagi, gibiro dak kuno nyaka chiengʼ, kendo Daudi jatichna nobed ruodhgi nyaka chiengʼ.
english: They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children’s children, forever. David my servant will be their prince forever.

kikuyu: To ne omak ondiek malichno kaachiel gi janabi mar miriambo, mane osetimo timbe honni e nyinge. Honnigo ema ne osewuondogo joma ne oketnegi kido mar ondiek malichno kendo negilamo gima ket kode. Ondiek malichno gi Janabi mar miriambo ne owiti kangima e ataro mar mach maliel mager.
english: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.

kikuyu: “To joga nodagi winjo dwonda kendo Israel nodagi timo kaka achikogi.
english: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

kikuyu: “Angʼo ma wanyalo timo ni jogi? Ji duto modak Jerusalem ongʼeyo maber ni gisetimo hono mongʼongʼore, kendo ok wanyal kwedo mano.
english: saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can’t deny it.

kikuyu: Weche moa e dho ngʼat man-gi rieko nigi ngʼwono, to ngʼama ofuwo tiekore mana gi wechene owuon.
english: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but a fool is swallowed by his own lips.

kikuyu: Mad tijeni nere gi jotichni, mad duongʼni nyisre ne nyithindi.
english: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.

kikuyu: Ngʼat mohero puonj mar rieko ohero ngʼeyo, to ngʼat ma ok winj puonj ofuwo.
english: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.

kikuyu: E kinde ngima Solomon duto Rezon nobedo jasik Israel, komedore gi chandruok mane Hadad okelo. Kamano Rezon nobedo ruodh Aram kendo noger gi jo-Israel.
english: He was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, in addition to the mischief of Hadad. He abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

kikuyu: Nodwoka niya, “Ikia gigi adier?” Nadwoke niya, “Ooyo ruodha, akiagi.”
english: Then the angel who talked with me answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”

kikuyu: To kata kamano Nadab gi Abihu notho kane gichiwo misango e nyim Jehova Nyasaye gi mach ma ok oyiego.)
english: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the LORD.

kikuyu: Jalok ohala tiyo gi ratinde mag miriambo; ohero mecho.
english: A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.

kikuyu: Emomiyo Nyasaye bende notingʼe malo moloyo, kendo nomiye nying moloyo nyinge duto,
english: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

kikuyu: “Ere ohala ma thona biro kelo, ere gima dhina e liel biro konyigo? Buru bende nyalo paki adier? Bende dohul adierani kasetho?
english: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

kikuyu: “Kuom mano, ok un ema ne uora ka to Nyasaye ema ne oora. En ema noketo abedo wuon Farao, ruoth mar ode duto kendo jatelo mar jo-Misri duto.
english: So now it wasn’t you who sent me here, but God, and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Amasa noriere piny kochadhore gi rembe e dier yo, kendo ngʼatno noneno ka jolweny duto ne chungʼ kochopo kanyo. Bende ka noneno ka ji duto chungʼ kochopo kama Amasa nothoeno, noywaye oko mar yo motere e pap moume gi law.
english: Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the middle of the highway. When the man saw that all the people stood still, he carried Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a garment over him when he saw that everyone who came by him stood still.

kikuyu: Misri ne mor kane giwuok, nikech mbi mar jo-Israel nosegore kuomgi.
english: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

kikuyu: kar penjo Jehova Nyasaye wach. Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nonege mokawo loch omiyo Daudi wuod Jesse.
english: and didn’t inquire of the LORD. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.

kikuyu: Kane wach ochopo e kar dak ruoth Farao ni owete Josef osebiro, Farao kaachiel gi jotije nomor.
english: The report of it was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, “Joseph’s brothers have come.” It pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

kikuyu: Gola oko e chwodho, kik iyie anim; resa e lwet joma ochaya, gola e chuny pi kama tut.
english: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

kikuyu: To abiro nyisou jalno monego uluor: Luoruru jalno ma, bangʼ nego ringruok, to en gi teko mar witou e ataro mar mach. Ee, awachonu, luoreuru.
english: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

kikuyu: Chik mane ogol mondo owe osiki mar yien gi tiendene nyiso ni pinyruodhi ibiro duogni chiengʼ ma iniyie ni polo ema nigi loch.
english: Whereas it was commanded to leave the stump of the roots of the tree, your kingdom shall be sure to you after you know that Heaven rules.

kikuyu: Magi ema ne jodonge madongo: Azaria wuod Zadok jadolo;
english: These were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;

kikuyu: Nochungo sirnigo e nyim hekalu koketo achiel yo milambo to machielo yo nyandwat. Mane oketo yo milambo noluongo ni Jakin to manoketo nyandwat noluongo ni Boaz.
english: He set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.

kikuyu: Yaye jaherana, ka aneno kaka ingʼiya, kod tigo malich miliero e ngʼuti, to chunya rumo.
english: You have ravished my heart, my sister, my bride. You have ravished my heart with one of your eyes, with one chain of your neck.

kikuyu: Eka nowachone jo-Keni niya, “Auru ka udhi mondo uwe jo-Amalek nikech ok adwar tiekou kodgi; nikech un ne utimo ngʼwono ni jo-Israel e kinde mane gia Misri.” Omiyo jo-Keni nowuok moweyo jo-Amalek.
english: Saul said to the Kenites, “Go, depart, go down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them; for you showed kindness to all the children of Israel when they came up out of Egypt.” So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

kikuyu: Kata obedo ni ngʼato lawi mondo otiek ngimani, to ngima mar ruodha notwe motegno gi kanyakla mar joma ngima gi Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi. To ngima wasiki to nowit mabor mana ka gima odir gorujre.
english: Though men may rise up to pursue you and to seek your soul, yet the soul of my lord will be bound in the bundle of life with the LORD your God. He will sling out the souls of your enemies as from a sling’s pocket.

kikuyu: nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu modak e dieru en Nyasaye ma janyiego kendo mirimbe ochomou kendo obiro tiekou e wangʼ piny.
english: for the LORD your God among you is a jealous God, lest the anger of the LORD your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.

kikuyu: en gima ber rito warruok mar Jehova Nyasaye.
english: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.

kikuyu: Chik iti kendo ibi ira, winj gima awacho mondo chunyi obed gi kwe. Abiro loso singruok mosiko kod herana mar adier mane asingone Daudi.
english: Turn your ear, and come to me. Hear, and your soul will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

kikuyu: Elija nodwoko jalwenyno niya, “Ka an ngʼat Nyasaye, to mach mondo oa e polo kendo otieki kaachiel gi jolweny magi piero abich.” Eka mach noa e polo mowangʼo jatend jolweny kod joge duto.
english: Elijah answered to the captain of fifty, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo kane koro ok anyal medo bedo mos, ne aoro jaote mondo angʼe kaka yieu chalo. Ne aluor ni dipo ka jatem osedonjore kodu mi omiyo tich mane watiyo matek e dieru obedo kayiem.
english: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

kikuyu: kendo nochako puonjogi. Nowachonegi niya,
english: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,

kikuyu: Gibiro ketho ohinga mag Turo kendo gibiro muko chiel mag-gi mag siro lweny; abiro ywero lope momewo oko mi odongʼ lwanda lilo.
english: They will destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.

kikuyu: Ka ngʼato odino ite ne chik, kata mana lemone bende richo.
english: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.

kikuyu: An, Johana ema nawinjo gigi kendo ne anenogi. To kane asewinjogi kendo nenogi, napodho piny e tiend malaika mane nyisagi.
english: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.

kikuyu: Weche mag Ruoth Lemuel, ma gin weche matut ma min mare nopuonje.
english: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:

kikuyu: Nyasaye ema oseikonwa chenro machalo kama, kendo osemiyowa Roho kaka singo, masingo gima biro.
english: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

kikuyu: Kar dhogeno it ngʼatno noyawore kendo lewe nogonyore mochako wuoyo maler.
english: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

kikuyu: Omiyo ruoth nochungʼ modhi obet e kome e dhorangach. Eka nonyis jolweny ni, Ruoth obet e dhorangach, kendo giduto negibiro mi gichungʼ e nyime. Koro nonwangʼo ka jo-Israel noseringo odhi e miechgi.
english: Then the king arose and sat in the gate. The people were all told, “Behold, the king is sitting in the gate.” All the people came before the king. Now Israel had fled every man to his tent.

kikuyu: Negiparo ni Nyasaye ema ne en lwanda margi, kendo ni Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo ema ne en Jawargi.
english: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

kikuyu: Nowacho niya, “Anamiyi piny Kanaan kaka girkeni mari.”
english: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”

kikuyu: Koa e dhood Naftali, nomigi, Kedesh man Galili (ma en dala maduongʼ mar pondo ne ngʼatno miparo kuome ni oneko), gi Hamoth Dor kod Kartan, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo adek.
english: Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Hammothdor with its pasture lands, and Kartan with its pasture lands: three cities.

kikuyu: ne omol e dier yo maduongʼ mar dalano. To bath aora koni gi koni ne nitie yath mar ngima manyago olembe kido apar gariyo kendo ne onyago olembegego dwe ka dwe, bende ite yadhno ema ithiedhogo ogendini mag pinje.
english: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

kikuyu: Negidak Bersheba, Molada, Hazar Shual,
english: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,

kikuyu: mondo tiengʼ mabiro ongʼegi, koda ka nyithindo mapok onywol, kendo gin bende ginyis nyithindgi.
english: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

kikuyu: E higa mar apar gariyo mar loch Ahaz ruodh Juda, Hoshea wuod Ela nobedo ruoth e piny Israel kodak Samaria kendo norito pinyno kuom higni ochiko.
english: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel for nine years.

kikuyu: Par jogi mane ingʼiewo chon gi lala, oganda ma gin girkeni mari, kendo mane iwaro, Got Sayun, kama in iwuon idakie.
english: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.

kikuyu: Ruth nodwoke niya “We chuna mondo aweyi kata apogra kodi. Kuma idhiyo ema an bende abiro dhiye, kendo kama idakie ema abiro dakie. Jogi ema nobed joga kendo Nyasachi ema nobed Nyasacha.
english: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.

kikuyu: Donge ngʼat marieyo ogendini kumo ji? Bende ngʼat mapuonjo dhano dibed maonge rieko?
english: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.

kikuyu: Nowach ne Saulo ni Daudi nosedhi Keila, omiyo nowacho niya, “Nyasaye osechiwe e lweta, nimar Daudi osetwere owuon ka odonjo e dala man-gi rangeye kod lodi.”
english: Saul was told that David had come to Keilah. Saul said, “God has delivered him into my hand, for he is shut in by entering into a town that has gates and bars.”

kikuyu: Ne nitie lweny e kind Asa kod Baasha ruodh Israel ndalo duto mag lochgi.
english: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

kikuyu: Guogi oselwora; oganda mar joma richo oseketa diere, gisetucho lwetena gi tiendena.
english: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.

kikuyu: bakunde piero ariyo mar dhahabu ma nengogi romo darik alufu achiel, kod gik moko ariyo mag nyinyo mowir mongʼith, bende maber ka dhahabu.
english: twenty bowls of gold weighing one thousand darics, and two vessels of fine bright bronze, precious as gold.

kikuyu: To ohinga mar dalano ne nigi mise apar gariyo, mane ondikie nying joote apar gariyo mag Nyarombo.
english: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.

kikuyu: Ok oyiene mondo ocham chiayo moro amora motho kende, kata ma ondiek onego, nikech timo kamano biro miyo obedo mogak. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
english: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Ngʼat ma jachan wedene duto kwede, osiepene to noringe maromo nadi! Kata bed notemo sayogi onge kama doyudgie.
english: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.

kikuyu: Tho kod kethruok ok rom ngangʼ, to kata mana wenge dhano bende ok rom.
english: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.

kikuyu: Ka jo-Amon noluongi mondo oik gige lweny mag-gi kendo gichokre Gilead, jo-Israel to nochokore Mizpa.
english: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together and encamped in Gilead. The children of Israel assembled themselves together and encamped in Mizpah.

kikuyu: Nikech odiechiengʼ gotieno lweti ne pek kuoma; tekrena ne oduono mana kaka timore e liet mar ndalo oro. Sela
english: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

kikuyu: “ ‘To un, joga Israel, yien nochak odong e gode mag Israel, mi nyagnu olembe, nikech ubiro dok e piny machiegni.
english: “‘“But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.

kikuyu: Ngʼat Makare ongʼeyo od ngʼat ma timbene richo kendo otero ngʼat marach e kethruok.
english: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.

kikuyu: kendo ji duto mane oyie kendo chunygi oelore nobiro mokelo mich ni Jehova Nyasaye kuom tich mar Hemb Romo gi tijene duto gi lewni mopwodhi mag dolo.
english: They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought the LORD’s offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments.

kikuyu: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha, kapo ni asetimo gima kamano adieri kendo lweta osetimo gima rach,
english: LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

kikuyu: Harun to nodwoko Musa niya, “Kawuono yawuota osetimo ni Jehova Nyasaye misango mar golo richogi giwegi kod misango miwangʼo pep, to kata kamano to koro neye gima osetimorena! To ka dine acham misango mar golo richoni kawuono, bende dine atimo maber e nyim Jehova Nyasaye?”
english: Aaron spoke to Moses, “Behold, today they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things as these have happened to me. If I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been pleasing in the LORD’s sight?”

kikuyu: Eka nowachone jotije niya, “Neuru puoth Joab omakore gi mara, kendo cham mar shairi ni e iye. Dhiuru umokie mach.” Omiyo jotij Abisalom nodhi momoko mach e puodhono.
english: Therefore he said to his servants, “Behold, Joab’s field is near mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire.” So Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.

kikuyu: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nopenjo Kain niya, “Ere owadu Abel?” Nodwoke niya, “Ok angʼeyo. An jakwadhe?”
english: The LORD said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”

kikuyu: An Jaduongʼ, Andikoni in Gayo osiepna mahero gi chunya.
english: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

kikuyu: Jo-Kristo Yesu madier duto oseguro e msalaba kit dhano machon gi gombone duto kod dwarone.
english: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

kikuyu: Nimar dhano ok ongʼeyo gima biro, en ngʼa manyalo nyise gima biro?
english: For he doesn’t know that which will be; for who can tell him how it will be?

kikuyu: Ngʼat makawore ni ongʼeyo gimoro kik par ni osengʼeyo moromo kaka dwarore.
english: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.

kikuyu: ma kata ja-bochne wuone to ok owinji, kata bed ni ja-bochneno olony machal nadi.
english: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

kikuyu: Otienono Nyasaye notimo kamano. Pien kende ema ne otwo; to lowo duto molwore ne thoo omoke.
english: God did so that night; for it was dry on the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.

kikuyu: Magi ema ne jotelo mar anywolagi: Efer, Ishi, Eliel Azriel, Jeremia, Hodavia kod Jadiel. Ne gin jolweny mathuondi kendo marahuma kendo jotend anywolagi.
english: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: “ ‘To kata kamano, abiro dwoko ne Sodom gi nyige mwanduge, kendo mwandu Samaria gi nyige bende abiro dwoko nigi, kod mwandugi bende abiro dwokoni kaachiel kodgi,
english: “‘“I will reverse their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of your captives among them;

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano nowuok modhi e sokono mokiro chumbi e iye kowacho niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: ‘Aseloso pigni obedo maber. Ok nochak okel tho kata weyo piny ma ok omew.’ ”
english: He went out to the spring of the waters, and threw salt into it, and said, “The LORD says, ‘I have healed these waters. There shall not be from there any more death or barren wasteland.’”

kikuyu: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Donge wachna chalo gi mach kendo ka nyundo matoyo kidi matindo tindo?”
english: “Isn’t my word like fire?” says the LORD; “and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi nodhi malo mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechike kokadho kuom Gad.
english: David went up according to the saying of Gad, as the LORD commanded.

kikuyu: “Dhano to en angʼo madimi obed ngʼama ler, koso dhano ma dhako onywolo, to en angʼo madimi obed ngʼama kare?
english: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

kikuyu: Bende en ema nonego ja-Misri ma borne ne fut abiriyo gi nus. Kata nobedo ni ja-Misrino ne nigi tongʼ machalo gi lodi e lwete, Benaya nodhi kedo kode kotingʼo arungu. Noyudho tongʼ e lwet ja-Misrino monege gi tonge owuon.
english: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

kikuyu: Moruru gi joma mor, kendo ywaguru gi joma ywak.
english: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

kikuyu: E kindeno Petro nochungʼ e kind joma oyie (mane nyalo romo ji mia gi piero ariyo)
english: In these days, Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,

kikuyu: nyaka chop Jehova Nyasaye nokul wangʼe piny ma onena gie polo.
english: until the LORD looks down, and sees from heaven.

kikuyu: Magi notingʼo jomatindo duto gi mon gi yawuowi kod nyiri duto mag dhoodno kaka ondikgi e nonro mar anywolagi. Negitimo gima nikare kuom pwodhruokgi.
english: and those who were listed by genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation; for in their office of trust they sanctified themselves in holiness.

kikuyu: Abiro guro singruokna e kinda kodi kendo anamed kothi obed mangʼeny.”
english: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”

kikuyu: Nopiem gi jatend ogendini mag polo, nomiyo misengini mane itimone jatelono orumo kendo kare maler mar lemo bende nokethi.
english: Yes, it magnified itself, even to the prince of the army; and it took away from him the continual burnt offering, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.

kikuyu: Nimar odiechieng chulo kuor ne ni e chunya kendo hik warruok osechopo.
english: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redeemed has come.

kikuyu: kendo ka oneno jolweny ka biro mondo oked kodu, bangʼe to ogoyo turumbete mondo ji oikre,
english: if, when he sees the sword come on the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people,

kikuyu: “Wachne jo-Israel kama: ‘Ka dichwo kata dhako okwinyo wadgi e yo moro amora kendo obedo ngʼama ok ja-ratiro ne Jehova Nyasaye, ngʼatno oketho
english: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against the LORD, and that soul is guilty,

kikuyu: Gari man-gi farese marotenge dhiyo kochomo yo nyandwat, gari man-gi farese marochere dhi kochomo yo podho chiengʼ, to gari man-gi farese marongʼeye dhi kochomo yo milambo.”
english: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country.”

kikuyu: E Ranga Soko negidhi nyime wangʼ achiel ka giidho raidhi mar Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi ka giluwo kor ohinga mi gikadho ewi od Daudi nyaka e Dhoranga Pi mantiere yo wuok chiengʼ.
english: By the spring gate, and straight before them, they went up by the stairs of David’s city, at the ascent of the wall, above David’s house, even to the water gate eastward.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mano Amazia nooro joote ir Jehoash wuod Jehoahaz, ma wuod Jehu ruodh Israel, kosieme niya, “Bi warom wangʼ gi wangʼ.”
english: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come, let’s look one another in the face.”

kikuyu: Awachonu ni, otienono ji ariyo nobed e kitanda achiel: achiel nokaw to machielo nowe.
english: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.

kikuyu: “Un polo lwaruru tim makare mondo ochwer kaka koth e piny. Un piny yawreuru malach mondo warruok obi, mondo tim makare odongi e piny, an Jehova Nyasaye achweyo magi duto.
english: Rain, you heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open, that it may produce salvation, and let it cause righteousness to spring up with it. I, the LORD, have created it.

kikuyu: Onge ngʼama nyalo chiwo kwayoni kari, kendo onge gima nyalo thiedhoni adhola, kata manyalo changi.
english: There is no one to plead your cause, that you may be bound up. You have no healing medicines.

kikuyu: Giwacho e kindgi giwegi ni, “Biuru mondo wakaw divai! Wamadhuru kongʼo mi wamer! Kendo kiny nochal mana gi kawuono, to bende onyalo bedo maber moloyo.”
english: “Come,” they say, “I will get wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and tomorrow will be as today, great beyond measure.”

kikuyu: Bende ngʼato nyalo wacho niya, “Ka miriambona nyalo miyo adiera mar Nyasaye medore, kendo duongʼne bende medo nyisore to marangʼo pod ingʼadona bura kaka jaricho?”
english: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

kikuyu: Jo-Negev nokaw piny gode mag Esau, kendo joma odak e tiend gode nokaw piny jo-Filistia, ginikaw nyaka piny Efraim gi Samaria, eka jo-Benjamin nokaw piny Gilead.
english: Those of the South will possess the mountain of Esau, and those of the lowland, the Philistines. They will possess the field of Ephraim, and the field of Samaria. Benjamin will possess Gilead.

kikuyu: Nadwoki piny miwuo mana koa ei lowo; kendo wecheni nowuog mana koa ei buru. Dwondi nochal mana ka dwond jachien moa ei lowo; kendo koa ei lowo dwondi nowinji.
english: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust.

kikuyu: Eka nopenjogi niya, “Marangʼo ne ok uchamo misango mar golo richo e kama ler mar lemo? En misango maler mane omiu mondo upwodhgo oganda kuom richogi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
english: “Why haven’t you eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is most holy, and he has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?

kikuyu: Odiechiengʼno duto lweny nomedo bedo mager kendo noten ruodh Israel e gache komanyore gi jo-Aram nyaka godhiambo mondo ojiw joge. Notho ka chiengʼ dhi podho.
english: The battle increased that day. However, the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the evening; and at about sunset, he died.

kikuyu: Gogi gi luoro, yaye Jehova Nyasaye; mi ogendini ongʼe ni gin mana dhano. Sela
english: Put them in fear, LORD. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.

kikuyu: Kagiwachoni niya, “Bi idhi kodwa; mondo wabuti ni ngʼato wanegi, kendo wamonj kayiem nono joma onge ketho;
english: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.

kikuyu: Kik irwak law molos gi yie rombo kod katana motwangʼ kanyakla.
english: You shall not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.

kikuyu: Samuel nowachonegi niya, “Jehova Nyasaye en janeno kuomu, kendo ngʼate mowir bende obedo janeno kawuononi, ni ok useyudo gimoro e lweta.” Negiwacho niya, “Adier, en janeno.”
english: He said to them, “The LORD is witness against you, and his anointed is witness today, that you have not found anything in my hand.” They said, “He is witness.”

kikuyu: Eka polo gi piny kod gik moko duto manie igi nokog gi ilo nikech Babulon, nimar koa nyandwat jonek nomonje,” Jehova Nyasaye wacho.
english: Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is therein, will sing for joy over Babylon; for the destroyers will come to her from the north,” says the LORD.

kikuyu: “Ne alawo wasika mi atiekogi; ne ok aweyogi nyaka negirumo.
english: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them. I didn’t turn again until they were consumed.

kikuyu: Jehoyada nogolo wuod ruoth oko mi osidhone osimbo mar loch; eka nomiye kitap chik mi okete ruoth. Ne giwire ka ji pamo lwetgi ka gigoyo koko niya, “Ruoth mondo odag amingʼa!”
english: Then he brought out the king’s son, and put the crown on him, and gave him the covenant; and they made him king and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, “Long live the king!”

kikuyu: “Nyis Eliazar wuod Harun, ma jadolo, mondo ogol tawo miwangʼo ubani kendo okee mirni mar mach mabor, nimar tawono ler
english: “Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter the fire away from the camp; for they are holy,

kikuyu: En Rimon, Zora, Jarmuth,
english: in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,

kikuyu: Mosnauru Apele, ngʼat mosetem moyud ni ja-Kristo mar adier. Jood Aristobulo bende mosnauru.
english: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

kikuyu: Ji duto mane ni e sinagogi ne mirima mager omako kane giwinjo wechegi.
english: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.

kikuyu: kendo Jehova Nyasaye nochiwogi e lwet jo-Israel. Negiloyogi mi gilawogi nyaka dala maduongʼ mar Sidon, nyaka Misrefoth Maim kendo nyaka Holo mar Mizpa ma yo wuok chiengʼ, maonge joma notony.
english: The LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them, and chased them to great Sidon, and to Misrephoth Maim, and to the valley of Mizpah eastward. They struck them until they left them no one remaining.

kikuyu: Jobathgi duto noyworogi gi gige fedha kod dhahabu, kod gik miuso gi kweth mag dhok, kod mich ma nengone tek, kaachiel gi chiwo mar hera.
english: All those who were around them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, with animals, and with precious things, in addition to all that was willingly offered.

kikuyu: joka Simeon ne gin ji alufu abiriyo gi mia achiel (7,100) mano oikore ne lweny,
english: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred.

kikuyu: kendo mondo anyis ji duto ongʼe maler tichna kuom wach mopondoni, mosebedo kopandi kuom Nyasaye mane ochweyo gik moko duto e higni mokalo.
english: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Ji biro biro koa yo wuok chiengʼ gi yo podho chiengʼ, gi yo nyandwat kod yo milambo, kendo ginibed keregi e kar nyasi mar chiemo manobed e pinyruoth Nyasaye.
english: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: bende ngʼe ni nyaka ia e nyathi isebedo kingʼeyo weche manie Muma Maler manyalo miyi rieko makeloni warruok kuom yie Kristo Yesu.
english: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Amedo wachonu ni kik ngʼato kawa ni afuwo. To ka uhero, to kawauru kaka ngʼama ofuwo, mondo an bende apakrae matin.
english: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

kikuyu: Omiyo noweyogi gi ruodh Moab mine gidak kode e ndalo duto mane Daudi ni kar pondo.
english: He brought them before the king of Moab; and they lived with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.

kikuyu: Magi duto oa kuom Nyasaye, mane ogolo sigu mane ni e kindwa kode kotimowa osiepene kuom Kristo, kendo omiyowa tich mar loko wasike osiepene:
english: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

kikuyu: kowachonegi niya, “Dhiuru e dala man nyimu cha, to ka udonjo e iye to ubiro nwangʼo nyathi kanyna mapok ngʼato oidho nyaka nene kotwe kanyo. Gonyeuru kendo ukele ka.
english: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him and bring him.

kikuyu: Magi e nying yawuot Ishmael ma nying-gi nochak miechgi kod kuonde mane gibworoe, ne gin ruodhi apar gariyo ngʼato ka ngʼato gi ogandane.
english: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.

kikuyu: Lwoka maler gi owino eka abiro bedo maler; lwoka mondo abed marachar moloyo pe.
english: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

kikuyu: Kane gichopo Mara, ne ok ginyal modho pi makanyo nikech nokech. (Mano emomiyo kanyo iluongo ni Mara.)
english: When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah.

kikuyu: Wach janabigino en adier. Omiyo kwergi matek mondo eka gibed gi yie mar adier,
english: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

kikuyu: Musa nodwokogi niya, “Horeuru nyaka angʼe gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho kuomu.”
english: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what the LORD will command concerning you.”

kikuyu: Eka Yesu noluongo oganda ire, kaachiel gi jopuonjrene mi owachonegi niya, “Ka ngʼato dwaro luwo bangʼa to nyaka okwedre kende owuon kendo otingʼ msalape eka oluwa.
english: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

kikuyu: to daher moloyo mondo amed bedo mangima e ringruok nikech un.
english: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

kikuyu: kendo Darius ja-Media nokawo loch mar piny ka en ja-higni piero auchiel gariyo.
english: Darius the Mede received the kingdom, being about sixty-two years old.

kikuyu: Otingʼo asere mondik ni Jerusalem e lwete ma korachwich, mondo omi ongʼe ni odhi Jerusalem, kogiyo sigich lweny kendo oloso lodi mitwomogo dhorangeye, bende ogingo pidhe mag lowo kendo okunyo buche milworogo ohinga.
english: In his right hand was the lot for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, and to build forts.

kikuyu: Kuom mano wach nigi ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Nikech uchamo ringʼo motimo remo kendo ugeno kuom nyisecheu muloso kendo uchwero remo, bende dukaw piny adier?
english: Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. So should you possess the land?

kikuyu: Eka naneno polo koyawore kendo naneno faras marachar kochungo e nyima ma jaithne iluongo ni Ja-ratiro, kendo Ja-adiera. Nikech ongʼado buchene e yo makare kendo okedo lwenjene gi ratiro.
english: I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.

kikuyu: Nogonyo jalno mane gikwayo, mane oyudo ni e od twech nikech koko kendo nikech nek, to Yesu noketo e lwetgi mondo gitimne kaka gidwaro.
english: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.

kikuyu: Nongʼicho kendo noyudo makati matin maliet motedi gi makaa koketi but wiye kod pi e agulu. Nochiemo mometho eka bangʼe kendo nodok monindo.
english: He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again.

kikuyu: “Asejiwo ngʼato mawuok nyandwat kendo obiro, en ngʼat maa yo wuok chiengʼ maluongo nyinga. Onyono Ruodhi mag piny mana ka lop muono, mi onywasgi mana kaka jachwech nywaso lop chweyo agulu.
english: “I have raised up one from the north, and he has come, from the rising of the sun, one who calls on my name, and he shall come on rulers as on mortar, and as the potter treads clay.

kikuyu: ma oriwo wan bende, wan moseluongowa, ok kuom jo-Yahudi kende, to kuom joma ok jo-Yahudi bende?
english: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

kikuyu: Jopuonjrego noa modhi Dala maduongʼ moyudo gik moko mana kaka Yesu nosewachonegi. Omiyo negiloso Sap Pasaka.
english: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

kikuyu: Kane Joshua kod jo-Israel noneno ka joma nopondo osekawo dala maduongʼ kendo iro bende ne dhwolore kanyo, negilokore mi gimonjo jo-Ai.
english: When Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned back and killed the men of Ai.

kikuyu: Bed mobuok kendo kiwuoro, dinuru wengeu kendo kik unen, meruru amera to ok gi divai, kendo themburu athemba to ok gi kongʼo.
english: Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

kikuyu: Gol chwat ma isechwadago oko; goch ma lweti goyago ohinga.
english: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

kikuyu: Abiro tieko gode madongo gi gode matindo kendo anami gik motwi kuome two; bende anami aore lokre pinje manie chula kendo nami yewni dwon.
english: I will destroy mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs. I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools.

kikuyu: Ne ok uneno Jehova Nyasaye gi wangʼu e kinde mane uwinjo dwonde koa e mach e got Horeb. Omiyo beduru motangʼ ahinya,
english: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that the LORD spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,

kikuyu: wuod Ethni, wuod Zera, wuod Adaya,
english: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

kikuyu: “ ‘Kane aluongo, ne ok giwinjo, omiyo gin bende kane giluongo to ne ok anyal yienegi,’ Jehova Nyasaye Maratego owacho.
english: It has come to pass that, as he called and they refused to listen, so they will call and I will not listen,” said the LORD of Armies;

kikuyu: Un ruodhi mag pinyni, daguru gi wasumbini magu kuritogi maber kendo mowinjore nikech ungʼeyo ni un bende un gi Ruodhu e polo.
english: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

kikuyu: Usethiro joma odhier ma kata cham matin magin godo usechunogi ma gimiyou kaka asoya. Kuom mano, usegero udi mabeyo mag kidi, to ok unudagie, to bende ok unumadhi divai mag mzabibu mabeyo musepidho,
english: Therefore, because you trample on the poor and take taxes from him of wheat, you have built houses of cut stone, but you will not dwell in them. You have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink their wine.

kikuyu: To un dine apidhou gi ngano maber mogik, kendo dine aromou gi mor kich ma athodho e lwanda.”
english: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”

kikuyu: Nodhi nyaka ir Pilato mokwayo ringre Yesu, kendo Pilato nogolo chik mondo omiyego.
english: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

kikuyu: Omiyo tich mane ni e od Nyasaye man Jerusalem nochungʼ nyaka e higa mar ariyo mar loch Darius ruodh Pasia.
english: Then work stopped on God’s house which is at Jerusalem. It stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

kikuyu: Mad Jehova Nyasaye ngʼad bura e kinda kodi. Mad Jehova Nyasaye chul kuor kuom gik maricho misetimona, an to lweta ok nomuli.
english: May the LORD judge between me and you, and may the LORD avenge me of you; but my hand will not be on you.

kikuyu: An bende abiro pamo lweta, kendo mirimba mager biro rumo. An Jehova Nyasaye ema asewacho kamano.”
english: I will also strike my hands together, and I will cause my wrath to rest. I, the LORD, have spoken it.”

kikuyu: Joma ochaya maonge gima omiyo ngʼeny moloyo yie wiya; joma olokore wasika kayiem thoth adier, jogogo madwaro mondo otieka. Ichuna mondo adwok gima ne ok akwalo.
english: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.

kikuyu: Eka Isaya wuod Amoz ne ooro wach ne Hezekia kama: “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: Nikech uselama kuom wach mar Senakerib ruodh Asuria,
english: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “The LORD, the God of Israel says, ‘Because you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,

kikuyu: Jonathan nowacho niya, “Wuora osekelo chandruok ne piny. Ne kaka koro Awinjo maber bangʼ bilo mor kich matin.
english: Then Jonathan said, “My father has troubled the land. Please look how my eyes have brightened because I tasted a little of this honey.

kikuyu: Chiwo mane gikelo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ne gin geche auchiel moum wiye gi rwedhi mabwoch apar gariyo. Jatelo ka jatelo nogolo rwadh bwoch achiel bende jotelo ariyo noriwore mochiwo gari achiel moum wiye. Gigi duto negikelo e nyim hekalu.
english: and they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox. They presented them before the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Kamano e kaka ne abet; chiengʼ nochama godiechiengʼ kendo koyo nochama gotieno, kendo nindo noringo oa e wangʼa.
english: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.

kikuyu: Jethro ne mor mar winjo gik mabeyo duto ma Jehova Nyasaye nosetimo ne jo-Israel kuom resogi e lwet jo-Misri.
english: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.

kikuyu: Petro nodwoke mowacho niya, “Ruoth, ka en in adier to nyisa mondo abi iri ka awuotho ewi pi.”
english: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

kikuyu: kinde mar keyo kite kod kinde mar chokogi, kinde mar kwakruok kod kinde mar weyo kwakruok,
english: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

kikuyu: Ruoth nomiyo giwangʼo lowo mane gisechweyo e paw Jordan man e kind Sukoth gi Zarethan.
english: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.

kikuyu: “Nyis jo-Israel kama: ‘Nyaka urit sabatona duto. Ma nobed ranyisi e kinda kodu nyaka ni tienge duto mabiro, mondo omi ungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye mamiyo ubedo maler.
english: “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

kikuyu: Jogo to ero temo ywayou korgi, to ngʼeuru ni gitimo kamano mana mar kethou. Gima gitemo timo en mana mondo gipogu kodwa, mondo gin ema umigi duongʼ moloyo wan.
english: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

kikuyu: Jogo ne geno ni lwete biro kuot, kata ni nobiro gore piny apoya mi otho, to negirito gamingʼa mi ok gineno gima otime. Eka negiloko pachgi mi giwacho ni Paulo en nyasaye.
english: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.

kikuyu: To Pilato nopenjogi niya, “Duher mondo agonynu ruodh jo-Yahudi koso?”
english: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

kikuyu: Wenge Jehova Nyasaye ni kuonde duto, karito joricho gi joma beyo.
english: The LORD’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

kikuyu: Mano emomiyo ne iluongo dalano ni Babel, nikech kanyo ema Jehova Nyasaye nopogoe dho ogendini kendo okeyogi e pinje duto.
english: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth. From there, the LORD scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.

kikuyu: Yawuot Shemaya ne gin, Othni, Refael, Obed kod Elzabad; Elihu kod Semakia ma wedene bende ne joma niginyalo.
english: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

kikuyu: Obed-Edom bende Nyasaye nogwedho gi yawuowi, wuowi makayo ne en Shemaya, mar ariyo ne en Jehozabad, mar adek ne en Joa, mar angʼwen ne en Sakar, mar abich ne en Nethanel,
english: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

kikuyu: Bath yien modongʼ opayo mi olosgo nyasaye, mokulorene kendo olamo. Olame kowacho niya, “Resa in e nyasacha.”
english: The rest of it he makes into a god, even his engraved image. He bows down to it and worships, and prays to it, and says, “Deliver me, for you are my god!”

kikuyu: “To in, wuod dhano, jothuru ochokore wuoyo kuomi ka gichokore e tok ohinga kendo ka gin e dhoutegi, ka moro ka moro kuomgi wacho ne wadgi ni, ‘Bi mondo uwinjie wach moa kuom Jehova Nyasaye.’
english: “As for you, son of man, the children of your people talk about you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak to one another, everyone to his brother, saying, ‘Please come and hear what the word is that comes out from the LORD.’

kikuyu: Asenono yorena kendo asechiko yorena mondo oluw yoreni.
english: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

kikuyu: nikech ne ok oloro dhoudi mag ii minwa mondo ne kik nywola kendo ane chandruok makoro anenogi.
english: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.

kikuyu: Giwuoyo kuomi gi paro marach; adier, wasiki tiyo gi nyingi e yo marach.
english: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.

kikuyu: To Abram nopenje niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, ere kaka anyalo ngʼeyo ni obiro bedo girkeni mara?”
english: He said, “Lord GOD, how will I know that I will inherit it?”

kikuyu: Josef nowacho ne jo-Misri-go niya, “Koro kaka asengʼiewou kawuononi ne Farao kaachiel gi puotheu, kodhi eri dhi ukom.
english: Then Joseph said to the people, “Behold, I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh. Behold, here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.

kikuyu: Omiyo Abram nowuok Misri gi chiege kod Lut kod gik moko duto mane en-go kochomo Negev.
english: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.

kikuyu: Negidwogo ir Musa gi Harun kod oganda jo-Israel duto e dala Kadesh manie Thim Paran. Kanyo ema ne gimiyogi dwoko kaachiel gi chokruok duto kendo neginyisogi olemo machiek e pinyno.
english: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.

kikuyu: Bangʼe Jeremia noduogo koa Tofeth, kama Jehova Nyasaye noore mondo okore wach, kendo nochungʼ e agola mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye mi owachone ji duto ni,
english: Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of the LORD’s house, and said to all the people:

kikuyu: Jerusalem osebedo gi ruodhi maroteke ka girito piny Yufrate duto, kendo osuru, chiwo ma ruoth ketone joma otelone, kod chudo moro amora mag gik miloko nochulgi.
english: There have also been mighty kings over Jerusalem who have ruled over all the country beyond the River; and tribute, custom, and toll was paid to them.

kikuyu: To Elihu wuod Barakel ja-Buz, mane wuok e anywola mar Ram ne iye owangʼ gi Ayub nikech nopwoyore kende owuon kaka ngʼat makare, ka ok oweyo Nyasaye ema mondo opwoye.
english: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.

kikuyu: Emomiyo an ok aringi ka ngʼama okia kuma itieke ngʼwech, bende ok athor diro ngum adira ka gima agoyo yamo nono.
english: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

kikuyu: To kane gidhi yike onge gima negiyudo makmana hanga wiye, tiendene gi lwetene.
english: They went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull, the feet, and the palms of her hands.

kikuyu: Jo-Juda duto nodwoko jo-Israel niya, “Ne watimo ma nikech ruoth en watwa machiegni. Angʼo momiyo iu owangʼ. Bende wasechamo gimoro moa ka ruoth? Bende wasekawoe gimoro ni wan wawegi?”
english: All the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, “Because the king is a close relative to us. Why then are you angry about this matter? Have we eaten at all at the king’s cost? Or has he given us any gift?”

kikuyu: Ipuro puothene kendo iloso oparane duto. Imiyo puothene bedo mangʼich, kendo igwedhe gi cham.
english: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

kikuyu: Nowa, ne en japur kendo en ema nokwongo pidho mzabibu mi olosogo divai.
english: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ mokwongo mar jumano nyaka ubed gi chokruok mowal, kendo kik uti tich moro amora ma utiyo pile.
english: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

kikuyu: omiyo onge ngʼama nyalo wacho ni noyudo batiso e nyinga.
english: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.

kikuyu: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho: “An gi nyiego maduongʼ nikech Sayun; kendo nyiego omaka malich nikech dalano.”
english: The LORD of Armies says: “I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.”

kikuyu: Thedhuru kwe mau olokre ligengni, to rabeti mau obed tonge. Ngʼat ma ngoro mondo owach niya, “An gi teko!”
english: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong.’

kikuyu: Bende nomiye chike mag migepe mag jodolo kod jo-Lawi to gi tije duto mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kaachiel gi gik moko duto mitiyogo e iye.
english: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of the LORD’s house, and for all the vessels of service in the LORD’s house—

kikuyu: Jetur, Nafish kod Kedema. Jogo duto ne yawuot Ishmael.
english: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

kikuyu: Kendo ondiek malichno nochungʼ e dho nam. Eka naneno ondiek moro magalagala kawuok aa e nam. Ne en gi tunge apar kod wiye abiriyo. To nosidho osimbo apar e tungenego, kendo wich ka wich nondikie nying marach ma yanyo Nyasaye.
english: Then I stood on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads, blasphemous names.

kikuyu: To kane gichopo ei ot, negineno nyathino kod Maria min mare, kendo negikulore piny ka gilame. Bangʼe ne giyawo mwandugi kendo negimiye mich mag dhahabu, gi ubani gi mane-mane.
english: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

kikuyu: Bende dodhi piny nyaka e dhorangeye mag tho? Koso bende dwalor kode nyaka ei lowo?”
english: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”

kikuyu: Yesu nodhi nyime kawachonegi niya, “Chikuru itu maber mondo uwinj weche miwachonu, nimar rapim mupimogo ema ibiro pimnugo un bende, kendo moloyo kanyo.
english: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.

kikuyu: Anapiedhgi gi odhech pietho e dhorangeye mag dala maduongʼ mar piny. Anakel lit kod kethruok ne joga, nimar gitamore loko yoregi.
english: I have winnowed them with a fan in the gates of the land. I have bereaved them of children. I have destroyed my people. They didn’t return from their ways.

kikuyu: Ma e kaka wangʼeyo gima hera en; Kristo nochiwonwa ngimane. Wan bende onego wachiw ngimawa ni owetewa.
english: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

kikuyu: Kane gisechopo e Holo mar Eshkol mi giringo pinyno, negimiyo chuny jo-Israel onyosore mar dhi e piny mane Jehova Nyasaye osemiyogi.
english: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.

kikuyu: To jo-Israel nobed gi kwe ma kata mana guok ok nogwe dhano kata chiayo.’ Bangʼ mano eka unungʼe ni Jehova Nyasaye keto pogruok e kind Misri gi Israel.
english: But against any of the children of Israel a dog won’t even bark or move its tongue, against man or animal, that you may know that the LORD makes a distinction between the Egyptians and Israel.

kikuyu: Nikech owacho niya, “ ‘Kuom teko mar bada kod riekona asetimo ma nikech an-gi winjo matut. Ne aketho tongʼ mag pinje, mi ayako mwandugi mathoth; kendo ka ngʼat maratego ne amako ruodhigo.
english: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding. I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.

kikuyu: Ruoth Daudi nowacho niya, “Luonguru Zadok jadolo gi Nathan janabi kod Benaya wuod Jehoyada.” Kane gibiro e nyim ruoth,
english: King David said, “Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada.” They came before the king.

kikuyu: “Nyaka ubed motangʼ, nikech nochiwu e lwet buche mag gwengʼ kendo norodhu gi del e sinagoke. Unuchungʼ kiyalou e nyim jotelo gi ruodhi nikech An, kendo unulandnegi Injili.
english: “But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.

kikuyu: Duongʼ mari ler okwako kendo iyombo gode momew gi kit le mayoreyore.
english: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

kikuyu: Kane jopuonjre owinjo wachni, ne gidhier nono kendo negipenjore niya, “Kare en ngʼa manyalo kwo?”
english: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”

kikuyu: Omiyo Daudi gi ji mia auchiel mane ni kode nowuok modhi ir Akish wuod Maok ma ruodh Gath.
english: David arose and passed over, he and the six hundred men who were with him, to Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

kikuyu: Kik iwe ohula ywera mi tera kata kut mwonya duto, kata bur matut um dhoge ka an e iye.
english: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.

kikuyu: mondo orese e lak tho, kendo kik tiek ngimane gi ligangla.
english: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

kikuyu: Nokawo gige lemo duto madongo gi matindo mane nitiere e hekalu mar Nyasaye, kod gik mane okan e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye gi gik moko duto mane okan e od ruoth kod od jodonge moterogi Babulon.
english: All the vessels of God’s house, great and small, and the treasures of the LORD’s house, and the treasures of the king and of his princes, all these he brought to Babylon.

kikuyu: Ja-Ethiopia nodwoko Filipo niya, “Ere kaka dawinj tiende kaonge ngʼama olerona tiende?” Omiyo norwako Filipo mondo oidh obed kode ei gari.
english: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

kikuyu: To gik ma Roho nyago gin hera, mor, kwe, horuok, ngʼwono, ber, bedo ja-adiera,
english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

kikuyu: Nikech kuom ngʼwono, useyudo warruok kuom yie, to ok nikech tim maber moro amora musetimo. En mich ma Nyasaye chiwo nono,
english: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

kikuyu: Awachonu adier ni ngʼato angʼata mamiyou pi e okombe e nyinga, nikech un jo-Kristo pokne ok nobaye ngangʼ.
english: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.

kikuyu: Joab noneno ni wasigu ni yo ka nyime gi yo katoke; omiyo noyiero jolweny mabeyo moloyo ei Israel, moketogi mondo giked gi jo-Aram.
english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel and put them in array against the Syrians.

kikuyu: Ne gitweye mi gitere nyaka ne gichiwe e lwet Pilato, mane en ruoth.
english: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

kikuyu: Lop Juda ema nogo tongʼ gi lop Reuben, kochakore yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka yo podho chiengʼ.
english: “By the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion.

kikuyu: Negikwangʼ gichopo e gwengʼ miluongo ni Gerasi, man loka nam Galili.
english: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

kikuyu: Awacho wechegi mondo uyud konyruok kuomgi, to ok mondo aketnu chik manyaka uluw. Adwaro ni udagi e yo maber, ka chiwruoku ni Ruoth ok opogore.
english: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

kikuyu: Boche polo gi mudho mandiwa oume; tim makare gi adiera e mise mar lochne.
english: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

kikuyu: Elija nodwoke niya, “Ikwayo gima tek to kineno ka ikawa adhi, to niyude; to ka ok ineno kikawa, to ok iniyudi.”
english: He said, “You have asked a hard thing. If you see me when I am taken from you, it will be so for you; but if not, it will not be so.”

kikuyu: jotelo mag jo-Amon nowachone Hanun ma ruodhgi niya, “Iparo ni Daudi miyo wuonu duongʼ ka ooro ji iri mondo ogoni mos? Donge Daudi oorogi mana mondo gibi ginon dala maduongʼ mondo oyud kaka dokawe?”
english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun their lord, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Hasn’t David sent his servants to you to search the city, to spy it out, and to overthrow it?”

kikuyu: To Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, Kwergi ni kik gidhi gikedi nimar ok anabed kodgi. Ibiro lowu gi wasiku.
english: The LORD said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you, lest you be struck before your enemies.’”

kikuyu: “Ka dhako modak gi chwore okwongʼore kata otwere gi kwongʼruok
english: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

kikuyu: Naluongo nyingi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ka an ei bur matut.
english: I called on your name, LORD, out of the lowest dungeon.

kikuyu: (Bezalel wuod Uri ma wuod Hur ja-dhood Juda noloso gik moko duto kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa;
english: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Paulo notieko kawachonegi niya, “Emomiyo adwaro ni ungʼe ni warruok mar Nyasaye osechopo ni joma ok jo-Yahudi, kendo gibiro rwake!” [
english: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”

kikuyu: Nobed kama winj tula rutoe kendo agak odakie. Nyasaye nopim timbe maricho mag Edom kod ketho mage.
english: But the pelican and the porcupine will possess it. The owl and the raven will dwell in it. He will stretch the line of confusion over it, and the plumb line of emptiness.

kikuyu: Weruru gi mor, yaye polo, nimar Jehova Nyasaye ema osetimo ma; koguru matek, yaye piny mamwalo. Weruru matek un gode, bunge kod yiende duto, nimar Jehova Nyasaye osereso Jakobo, kendo osenyiso ayanga duongʼ mare e Israel.
english: Sing, you heavens, for the LORD has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains, O forest, all of your trees, for the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and will glorify himself in Israel.

kikuyu: Mana kaka ji mangʼeny nobwok konene, kite ne olokore makoro ne ok ochal ka dhano, kendo kite nokethore mopogore gi kit dhano,
english: Just as many were astonished at you— his appearance was marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men—

kikuyu: “Uparo nade? Ne nitie ngʼato moro mane nigi yawuowi ariyo. Nodhi ir mokwongo mowachone ni, ‘Kawuono dhi iti e puoth mzabibu.’
english: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’

kikuyu: Jo-Lawi gi jo-Juda notimo kaka Jehoyada jadolo nochikogi. Jatend migawo ka migawo nokawo joge mane dhi tich chiengʼ Sabato to gi mago mane onego oywe, nikech Jehoyada ne ok omiyo migepe mamokogi thuolo.
english: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded. They each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath, with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, for Jehoiada the priest didn’t dismiss the shift.

kikuyu: Yesu nopenjogi niya, “Angʼo ma uminoe wach kodgi?”
english: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”

kikuyu: Kutimo kamano, to ubiro ngʼeyo adiera kendo adiera nomi ubed thuolo.”
english: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”

kikuyu: Eka nowacho niya, “Kaka ingʼeyo, pinyruoth ne mara. Jo-Israel duto nongʼiya kaka ruodhgi. To gik moko nolokore ma pinyruoth nodok ni owadwa; nimar Jehova Nyasaye ema osemiyego.
english: He said, “You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign. However, the kingdom is turned around, and has become my brother’s; for it was his from the LORD.

kikuyu: nikech ohero pinywa kendo osegeronwa sinagogi.”
english: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”

kikuyu: Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Gik ma apuonjo ok gin maga awuon, to gin mag Jal mane oora.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

kikuyu: “Ka wan koth Nyasaye kamano, to koro ok onego wapar ni Nyasaye chalo gi dhahabu kata gi fedha kata kidi, ma gin mana kido ma dhano oloso kendo oketo gi pache.
english: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.

kikuyu: Ruoth nodwoke niya, “Ka ngʼato owachoni gimoro, to mondo ikele ira, ma ok nochak ochandi kendo.”
english: The king said, “Whoever says anything to you, bring him to me, and he will not bother you any more.”

kikuyu: Kane Josef obiro irgi kinyne gokinyi, noneno ka chunygi ool.
english: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad.

kikuyu: Kawuononi, kata bedni an e ngʼat mowir mondo obed ruoth to abwok, yawuot Zeruya-gi otamo wangʼa. Mad Jehova Nyasaye chul kuor ni ngʼama timne rach marom gi timbene maricho!”
english: I am weak today, though anointed king. These men, the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May the LORD reward the evildoer according to his wickedness.”

kikuyu: Machiegnini mirimba kodu biro rumo kendo koro abiro chomogi tir mondo atiekgi.”
english: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”

kikuyu: Ruoth, ma nyinge Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya, “Moab nokethi kendo mier mage nomonji; yawuote mabeyo noter e kar nek.
english: Moab is laid waste, and they have gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men have gone down to the slaughter,” says the King, whose name is the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Koro aa malo idhi Damaski kendo ibiro nyisi gima nyaka itim.”
english: But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”

kikuyu: ne en ndalo ma yorega ne dhi maber kendo yiende mag zeituni ne nyak maber.
english: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

kikuyu: Yesu noomo chunye amingʼa bangʼe owacho niya, “Tiengʼni dwaro ranyisi mar hono nangʼo? Awachonu adier ni onge ranyisi moro amora mibiro migi.”
english: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

kikuyu: Kuom ohala mane itimo alanda ne ipongʼ gi timbe mag mahundu, mine idoko jaricho. Emomiyo ne adiri oko ka wichkuot omaki, ka agoli e got mar Nyasaye, kendo ne ariembi chuth, yaye kerubi ma jarit, mi ia e dier kite maliet ka mach.
english: By the abundance of your commerce, your insides were filled with violence, and you have sinned. Therefore I have cast you as profane out of God’s mountain. I have destroyed you, covering cherub, from the middle of the stones of fire.

kikuyu: Chiengʼ moro achiel kane olemo e hekalu mar Nisrok nyasache, yawuote miluongo ni Adramelek gi Shareza nonege gi ligangla, bangʼe negiringo gidhi e piny Ararat. Kendo Esarhadon wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
english: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: E seche mane otimo ma, jogo mane opondo noa malo piyo ka giringo gidonjo e dala maduongʼ. Bangʼ kane gisekawe, ne giwangʼe mana gisano.
english: The ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand and entered into the city and took it. They hurried and set the city on fire.

kikuyu: To e ohinga mar Susa, jo-Yahudi nonego motieko ji mia abich.
english: In the citadel of Susa, the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men.

kikuyu: To sani Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya: Kapok okadho higni adek, mana kaka ja-otongʼo tiyo kaparo hignige adek ma tije rumogo e kaka duongʼ mar Moab kaachiel gi joge mangʼeny duto none achaya, bende joge ma notony nobed manok kendo mayom yom.
english: But now the LORD has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”

kikuyu: To koro sani iyala nikech geno ma an-go kuom singruok mane Nyasaye otimo ne kwerewa.
english: Now I stand here to be judged for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers,

kikuyu: to nikech dhako ma chwore othoni osiko chanda, abiro neno ni angʼadone bura kare, mondo kik oola gibiro ma obirogo ira pile!’ ”
english: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”

kikuyu: Ubiro doko mafuta mimokogo mach rembu biro chwer e pinyu, ok nochak oparu kendo; nimar an Jehova Nyasaye ema asewacho kamano!’ ”
english: You will be for fuel to the fire. Your blood will be in the middle of the land. You will be remembered no more; for I, the LORD, have spoken it.”’”

kikuyu: Daudi nowachone ja-Filistiano niya, “Ibirona gi ligangla kod tongʼ gi bidhi, anto abironi e nying Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach jolweny Israel ma iseyanyo.
english: Then David said to the Philistine, “You come to me with a sword, with a spear, and with a javelin; but I come to you in the name of the LORD of Armies, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.

kikuyu: Eka jo-Juda gi jo-Jerusalem duto kotelnegi kod Jehoshafat nodok Jerusalem ka gimor gi ilo nikech Jehova Nyasaye nomiyogi mor kuom loyo wasikgi.
english: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, with Jehoshaphat in front of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.

kikuyu: to Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Asenyisou honni madongo mangʼeny moa ka Wuora. Kuom honnigi duto, en mane kuomgi ma udwaro chielane gi kite?”
english: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”

kikuyu: To un, ringreu nodongʼ e thim.
english: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.

kikuyu: Bangʼ mani chiege Elizabeth nomako ich to kuom dweche abich ne ok owuok oko.
english: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,

kikuyu: Kum wuodi, to obiro miyi kwe; kendo obiro kelo mor ne chunyi.
english: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.

kikuyu: gik ma joma riek osehulo, ka ok gipando gimoro amora mane giyudo kuom kweregi,
english: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;

kikuyu: Ne gilwoko garino e yawo moro Samaria (kama ochode lwokoree), kendo guogi nonangʼo rembe, mana kaka wach Jehova Nyasaye nosewacho.
english: They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed themselves, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke.

kikuyu: Jowetena, tiend gima awacho ema: Ringruok gi remo ok nyal chamo girkeni mar pinyruodh Nyasaye kendo gima tow ok nyal rwakore gi gima ok tow.
english: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.

kikuyu: E ndalogo Hezekia nobedo matuo kendo nohewore, omiyo nolamo Jehova Nyasaye mane odwoke kendo nomiye ranyisi mar hono.
english: In those days Hezekiah was terminally ill, and he prayed to the LORD; and he spoke to him, and gave him a sign.

kikuyu: Nikech kapod wadak e kiruni, to wachur gi pek modiyowa, to mano ok onyiso ni wadwaro weyo ringruok mawan-goni, to wagombo rwakore gi ringruok manyien mar polo, mondo gima ok tho omwony mano matho.
english: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

kikuyu: Kechne chopo kuom jogo moluore chakre tiengʼ ka tiengʼ.
english: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.

kikuyu: Eka Hazael noa ir Elisha modok ir ruodhe. To kane Ben-Hadad openje niya, “Angʼo mane Elisha owachoni.” Hazael nodwoke niya, “Nowachona ni kuom adier ibiro chango.”
english: Then he departed from Elisha, and came to his master, who said to him, “What did Elisha say to you?” He answered, “He told me that you would surely recover.”

kikuyu: Kik iket genoni kuom ruodhi mag piny, kata kuom dhano matho ma ok nyal waro ngʼato,
english: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.

kikuyu: Kuom mano, iniluw yore joma beyo kendo irit yore joma kare.
english: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

kikuyu: To kinda nyaka chop kare chuth eka unyalo doko motegno ma ok uremo gimoro.
english: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

kikuyu: Angʼeyo bende ni isebedo kiwinja ndalo duto, to asewacho wechegi mondo joma ochungʼ ka oyud konyruok, kendo mondo giyie nine iora adier.”
english: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”

kikuyu: Nimar in Jehova Nyasaye, e Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo mohewo piny duto; iduongʼ kendo iyombo nyiseche mamoko duto mabor.
english: For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.

kikuyu: Ka giwinjo koko mar tiend farese ma giro, kod koko mar geche wasigu to gi moor tiend gechegi. Wuone ok nokony nyithindgi; lwetgi kalandhidhi nomaki.
english: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers don’t look back for their children because their hands are so feeble,
